title: AI Creative Lead (Remote)
description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.
   

  

 We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
   

  

 Forbes Advisor is hiring an
 ****AI Creative Lead****
 to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on\-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct\-response marketing, and a hands\-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character\-locked stills through AI video, lip\-sync, and voiceover to editor\-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed.
   

  

 The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re\-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. You have shipped AI\-generated video that ran as paid creative, and you can tell real\-ad output from output that just reads as AI.
   

  

 We are a human\-led shop that uses AI to move faster without diluting craft. You protect the craft bar rather than lowering it to what the model makes easy, and you stay current with a stack that turns over frequently, treating every tool pick as a short\-term decision.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own generation end\-to\-end for paid social and native creative: character\-locked stills, AI video, lip\-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor\-ready footage.
* Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot.
* Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native\-audio vs. img\-to\-video) and keep a live view of a fast\-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time.
* Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available.
* Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto\-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass.
* Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan\-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one.
* Own the generative\-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor\-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards.
* Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes.
* Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on\-voice, on\-persona, and matched beat\-for\-beat to the script (AV sync).
* Bring a direct\-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good.
* Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better\-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline.
* Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales.
* Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self\-serve the routine work.


**Requirements**
* 4\+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands\-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables.
* A real grounding in direct\-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished.
* Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI\-generated or AI\-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed.
* Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi\-subject\-consistency image models, AI video (native\-audio and img\-to\-video), lip\-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade\-offs, not just tool names.
* Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame.
* Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re\-rolling until something lands.
* Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue.
* A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft.
* Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high\-output content environment. Comfortable shipping many cuts and variants a week across multiple categories.
* Comfort working inside compliance rails (regulated\-category claims, platform ad policy, partner brand guardrails).
* Strong collaboration across Creative, Production, Post, and Buying, and clear written communication for briefs, prompt docs, and learnings.
* Self\-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a start\-up style operating environment where the tools change under you.


****STRONG PLUSES****
* Generative video that has run as paid social or DR creative with attributable performance, not only brand or experimental work.
* Concepting or copywriting experience on DR ads, so you can improve a script or angle, not just execute it.
* Direct experience generating for regulated DR categories and getting their renders through platform filters.
* Video editing or motion/VFX background (Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci) that lets you hand editors better material and speak their language.
* Experience building reusable AI workflows for creative production: prompt libraries, character\-reference systems, Claude Projects or custom GPTs, or agentic tooling that compounds team output.
* Familiarity with DAM systems (Air, Frame.io, or comparable) and production project\-management tooling.
* Comfort reading performance dashboards (Looker, Tableau, in\-platform reporting) to close the loop between what rendered and what converted.
* A track record of picking up brand\-new tools fast and forming a real point of view on them, because this stack turns over monthly.

title: AI Creative Producer, Vertical Drama
description:
**About Zing** 




 We are a fast\-growing digital entertainment company specializing in high\-quality vertical miniseries and UGC ads for global audiences. Through innovative storytelling and audience\-driven approaches, we aim to captivate mobile\-first viewers with fast\-paced, engaging, and emotionally compelling content. Our mission is to redefine short\-form entertainment by integrating creativity, data\-driven insights, and cross\-cultural perspectives.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The AI Creative Producer, Vertical Drama owns both the creative and operational success of Zing's AI\-produced vertical drama slate, end to end. This is a hybrid director/producer role: you set the visual and storytelling direction for each series, and you also run the vendor relationships, timelines, budgets, and delivery process that get it made. You are the single point of accountability between Zing's leadership and its external AI production partners — translating scripts into production\-ready creative direction, briefing and managing AI vendors, reviewing every stage of delivery for both creative quality and operational compliance, and making sure episodes ship on time, on budget, and on brand.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Creative Direction**



* Lead AI\-powered vertical short drama projects from script breakdown through final delivery.
* Translate scripts into production\-ready visual plans: scene breakdowns, shot lists, character references, location references, style guides, and AI production requirements.
* Guide AI image and video generation; review style frames, character tests, motion tests, rough cuts, and final deliverables, and give clear, actionable notes on continuity, performance, composition, pacing, and tone.
* Strengthen episode\-level hooks, cliffhangers, reversals, and emotional escalation for 1–3 minute vertical episodes.
* Maintain visual, character, and story consistency across episodes and series.
* Supervise post\-production — editing, sound, music, subtitles, and final polish.



**Production \& Vendor Management**



* Serve as the primary point of contact between Zing and external AI production vendors and partners.
* Own project timelines, budgets, and resource/vendor allocation across multiple concurrent productions.
* Communicate creative briefs, visual references, production standards, delivery timelines, and revision notes to vendors, and hold them to Zing's technical specs (9:16 format, 1–3 min episodes) and quality benchmarks.
* Manage legal and logistical documentation, including contracts, deliverables, and release forms.
* Identify production risks, bottlenecks, and vendor concerns; propose mitigations and escalate to leadership as needed.
* Enforce SOP compliance across all productions and proactively build relationships with new top\-tier AI production vendors.



**Systems \& Continuous Improvement**



* Build repeatable AI production workflows: vendor briefing templates, character bibles, prompt guidelines, review checklists, and delivery specifications.
* Translate platform data, audience feedback, and ad performance learnings into creative and production improvements.
* Help define Zing's internal AI vertical drama production playbook and quality standards.
* Monitor emerging AI tools, trends, and vendor capabilities to keep Zing's workflows and partner network competitive.



  





**Qualifications** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in vertical/short\-form drama production — as a director, showrunner, creative producer, or producer — with real credits in the format (not adjacent film/TV only).
* Direct working experience using AI creative tools specifically for vertical drama production, e.g. Seedance, Runway, Kling, Midjourney, Flux, ComfyUI, Pika, Luma, or similar, in an actual production pipeline (not just personal experimentation).
* Strong understanding of vertical drama structure and mechanics: hooks, reversals, cliffhangers, emotional escalation, fast\-payoff storytelling.



**Also Important** 



* Proven experience managing external vendors, production partners, or outsourced/remote production teams, ideally across several projects at once.
* Strong visual storytelling ability — framing, shot design, blocking, mood, performance direction, edit rhythm — paired with equally strong organizational and project\-management skills.
* Comfortable owning budgets, timelines, contracts, and vendor accountability, not just creative notes.
* Strong taste in commercial, female\-driven vertical drama genres: romance, fantasy, revenge, billionaire, werewolf, mafia, forbidden love, melodrama, or similar high\-retention genres.
* Familiarity with production/workflow tools such as Airtable, Notion, or Frame.io.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable managing multiple stakeholders (leadership, vendors, AI artists) at once.
* Fluent English required; Mandarin proficiency is a strong plus for coordinating with overseas AI production partners.
* Must be based in or able to work from Los Angeles.
* A portfolio or work sample — director reels, vendor briefs, visual lookbooks, storyboards, or produced vertical series — is strongly preferred.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Engine**
 Engine is the all\-in\-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K\+ businesses and groups representing 1\.8M\+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, the fastest\-growing company in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI\-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.
   

  

 That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025\), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026\), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026\).
   

  

 We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high\-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

 Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in\-product moments, and beyond.
   

  

 You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high\-performing, on\-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.
   

  

 This is a role for a creative leader who wants to

**What You'll Own**
* **The AI\-assisted creative engine.** 
 Design the end\-to\-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.

 Continuously experiment with emerging creative technology, agencies, and production models. Partner with Growth's technical resources to leverage open\-source libraries and build new capabilities that increase the speed, quality, and scale of creative production.

 Treat creative as an audience filter and a growth lever. Build frameworks for high\-performing creative territories, connect testing insights and customer behavior to new ideas, and diagnose what's working through signals like hook rate, hold rate, conversion, and creative decay.

 Lead creative for events, conferences, activations, and field moments. Design experiences that make the brand felt, earn attention in the room, and create stories and assets that travel far beyond the event itself.

 Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test\-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in\-person moments.
   

  

 Lagging indicators include efficient acquisition and pipeline driven by creative and events, with creative quality and brand fit maintained as output scales.

* Craft pedigree in copy, art direction, design, or video that grounds your strategic judgment.
* Strong performance fluency: you're comfortable with the metrics and know how to translate data and creative signals into the next iteration.

 Base Pay Range

title: Creative Director, Brand Studio
description:
**About GitHub**
 GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.
   

  

**Locations**
 In this role you can work from Remote, United States
   

  

**Overview**
 GitHub is looking for a Creative Director to lead our Brand Studio, our world class creative design team responsible for shaping how GitHub shows up in the world.
   

  

 This team creates the visual identity and creative systems behind GitHub’s most important marketing moments, from global events and product launches to executive presentations, social content, blog storytelling, motion, illustration, and beyond. The work is highly visible, deeply cross\-functional, and central to how developers, customers, and Hubbers experience the GitHub brand.
   

  

 We’re looking for a creative leader who can guide a world\-class team without over\-directing it. Someone who understands how to translate executive priorities, brand strategy, product narratives, and business needs into clear creative direction. The ideal candidate will protect focus, raise the bar, and help the team do its best work, not by getting into every pixel, but by creating the conditions for great creative to happen.
   

  

 This role reports to the VP of Global Brand \& Marketing and will lead a tight\-knit, high\-functioning team of brand designers, motion designers, illustrators, and presentation designers.
   

  

 What success looks like:
   

  

 The right Creative Director will help GitHub’s Brand Studio continue to operate at a world\-class level while giving the team sharper focus, stronger connective tissue, and clearer creative direction.
   

  

 They will not be expected to reinvent a high\-functioning team from scratch. Instead, they will help the studio scale its impact: interpreting the needs of the business, protecting the craft, strengthening the brand system, and ensuring GitHub’s creative work feels unmistakably GitHub—whether it appears on a keynote stage, in a campaign, on social, in a product launch, or inside a deck for our most senior leaders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead GitHub’s Brand Studio team, providing clear creative direction, strong people leadership, and thoughtful prioritization across a broad range of marketing and brand work.
* Translate business, brand, product, and executive signals into compelling creative strategy and actionable direction for the team.
* Partner closely with Brand Strategy \& Narrative, Integrated Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, Events, Communications, Social, Web, Brand Experience, and executive stakeholders to ensure the GitHub brand is showing up with clarity, consistency, and creative excellence.
* Guide the development of visual systems for campaigns, events, launches, executive storytelling, social moments, editorial content, presentations, and other high\-impact brand experiences.
* Protect the team’s focus by helping sort signal from noise, clarify priorities, manage stakeholder expectations, and ensure the studio is working on the highest\-value creative opportunities.
* Champion the GitHub visual identity, ensuring the brand remains distinct, modern, developer\-authentic, and creatively ambitious.
* Evolve scalable creative systems, templates, guidelines, and design practices that allow the brand to travel consistently across teams, channels, and regions.
* Maintain the team’s culture grounded in trust, craft, collaboration, experimentation, and high standards.
* Coach and develop a talented team of creative specialists, helping each person grow their impact while preserving the autonomy and creative energy that make the studio special.
* Partner with external agencies, freelancers, and production partners when needed, ensuring outside work meets GitHub’s creative bar and brand standards.
* Work closely with the Brand Experience (site) team to ensure the brand is clear, cohesive, and compelling across all web and product surfaces.


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* 12\+ years experience in product or brand design
+ OR Bachelor's Degree in Industrial, Graphic or Motion Design, Product Design, Human Computer Interaction, or related field AND 10\+ years experience in product or brand design
+ OR Master's Degree in Industrial, Graphic or Motion Design, Product Design, Human Computer Interaction, or related field AND 8\+ years experience in product or brand design
+ OR Doctorate in Industrial, Graphic or Motion Design, Product Design, Human Computer Interaction, or related field AND 6\+ years experience in product or brand design
+ OR equivalent experience.

* 5\+ years designing brand systems, visual identity, creative production, and how design scales across marketing channels and organizational needs.
* 5\+ years people management experience


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* A genuine curiosity about developers, software, AI, open source, and GitHub’s role in shaping the future of how the world builds.
* Strong stakeholder management instincts, including the ability to push back with diplomacy, protect creative quality, and keep teams focused.
* Experience partnering across marketing, product, events, communications, web, and executive teams.
* Proven ability to lead senior creative talent without micromanaging. Setting direction, sharpening ideas, and raising the bar while giving teams room to do their best work.
* Ability to balance creative ambition with business realities, timelines, resources, and operational constraints.


**Compensation Range**
 The base salary range for this job is USD $140,400\.00 \- USD $372,300\.00 /Yr.
   

  

 These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.
   

  

 This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

* Ship to learn
* Growth mindset
* Own the outcome
* Better together
* Diverse and inclusive


**Manager fundamentals**
* Model
* Coach
* Care


**Leadership principles**
* Create clarity
* Generate energy
* Deliver success

We’re also home to the biggest open\-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open\-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
   

  

 Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote\-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
   

  

 Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

 and lift those around you.

 of your work and your impact.

 and make every action count.

title: TRESSE — Freelance Creative Director
description:
**Project:** Brand Development \+ Launch Creative Direction  
**Engagement:** Freelance / Contract  
**Initial term:** Approximately 6\-8 weeks  
**Industry:** Beauty / Hair / Luxury Services  
**Location:** Norcross, GA; hybrid/remote possible, with some in\-person availability preferred

About Tresse

Tresse is a new elevated braid bar created to modernize the traditional braiding experience.

Our goal is not simply to provide beautiful braids. Tresse is being built around a more polished, reliable and thoughtfully designed client experience—combining exceptional braiding with efficiency, comfort, professionalism and hospitality.

We want Tresse to feel like a **beauty brand that happens to specialize in braiding**, rather than simply another braid salon.

We are seeking a freelance Creative Director to help translate that vision into a distinctive and recognizable brand.

**The Assignment**

The Creative Director will work directly with the founder to establish the creative world of Tresse and develop the visual and experiential direction for its launch.

The goal is **not to completely reinvent the existing concept**. Tresse already has an initial identity and direction. We are looking for someone who can refine it, challenge it where appropriate, and develop it into a sophisticated and cohesive brand system.

The Creative Director should help answer:

**What should someone see, feel and immediately understand when they encounter Tresse?**

**Scope \& Deliverables**

The project will focus on six areas:

**1\. Brand Creative Direction**  
Develop the overarching creative concept and visual world for Tresse, including mood, visual references, typography direction, color application, graphic treatments and imagery.

**2\. Brand Identity Refinement**  
Evaluate the existing Tresse logo, black\-and\-gold direction and other brand elements. Recommend refinements where necessary while developing a more ownable visual identity.

**3\. Brand Voice \& Messaging**  
Establish guidelines for how Tresse communicates across social media, website/booking, advertising, client communications and physical signage.

This should include how we communicate the idea of **elevated braiding** without relying on generic luxury language.

**4\. Client Experience Creative Direction**  
Help translate the brand into the physical experience—including salon environment, signage, client amenities, refreshments, presentation, uniforms/smocks, packaging and other touchpoints.

**5\. Launch Campaign \+ Content Direction**  
Develop the creative concept for Tresse's launch, including social media direction, launch storytelling, campaign concepts and initial content pillars.

**6\. Launch Photoshoot Direction**  
Develop the concept and shot list and help direct the visual execution of Tresse's launch photography/video, including models, hairstyles, wardrobe, styling, composition and overall visual treatment.

At the conclusion of the project, the Creative Director should provide a comprehensive **Tresse Creative/Brand Playbook** documenting the final direction so future photographers, designers, social\-media managers and other creatives can execute the brand consistently.

It should include things such as approved visual direction, typography/color usage, imagery direction, photography guidelines, brand voice, social/content direction, graphic treatments, examples of correct/incorrect execution and launch creative direction.

**Who We're Looking For**

We are especially interested in creative directors with experience in **beauty, fashion, luxury consumer brands, hospitality, wellness or culturally relevant lifestyle brands**.

Prior salon experience is not required.

We are looking for someone with strong taste, but more importantly, someone who understands **brand strategy and can explain the reasoning behind creative decisions**.

The ideal candidate is comfortable challenging ideas when there is an opportunity to make the brand more distinctive.

Please do not apply with only logo/graphic\-design examples. We would like to see complete brand or campaign work demonstrating concept development, creative direction and execution.

Pay: $2,500\.00 \- $4,000\.00 per year

 Nothing is impossible— If you can shop it, we can do it.

title: Studio Director
description:
Westside Design, in partnership with Westside Build, is a Santa Monica\-based design and construction firm rebuilding homes across the Pacific Palisades in the wake of the wildfire. We bring architecture, design, and construction under one roof, with a strong emphasis on technology, speed, and craft.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Studio Director** 
 to lead an entire studio across client management, contracts, design, technical coordination, and delivery. This is a senior leadership role for someone who can operate as a broad\-based leader rather than a narrow specialist, someone who can move between client conversations, project strategy, technical issues, team leadership, and day\-to\-day studio needs with ease.
   

  

 This role is intended to be more of a multi\-tool leadership position: a person who can talk about contracts, deal with clients, guide design, engage technical and CA issues, and help support the Managing Principal lead the full studio. The Studio Director will directly lead our Project Managers and Project Architects, who are responsible for BIM model development, construction documentation, and permit\-ready deliverables in Revit. You will set the design intent and quality bar that the team documents and executes against, review their work at key milestones, and serve as the design authority they escalate to on coordination, code, and client\-facing design decisions.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 13\+ years of professional experience in architecture, residential design\-build, or a comparable studio environment
* 8\+ years leading complex residential projects through design, technical coordination, and delivery
* 5\+ years in a senior leadership role spanning client management, contracts, team oversight, and project execution
* Residential experience, especially custom homes, ADUs, and rebuild work
* Proven ability to lead across contracts, client management, design discussions, technical coordination, and CA
* Strong leadership presence and sound judgment in a fast\-moving environment
* Experience overseeing teams, projects, and multiple stakeholder relationships
* Strong communication skills and the ability to operate effectively with clients, internal teams, and leadership
* Must bring direct experience in a comparable leadership seat; this is not intended as a step\-up role from PM or senior project architect


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years in a role such as Studio Director, Senior Project Manager, Design Director, or similar leadership role
* Experience in integrated architecture/construction or design\-build settings
* Familiarity with consultant coordination, construction documentation, and field\-related problem solving


**Studio Leadership**
* Lead the overall performance of the studio across client service, project execution, staffing coordination, and day\-to\-day operations
* Serve as a senior leader helping guide studio priorities, unblock issues, and maintain momentum across multiple active projects
* Partner with firm leadership on studio structure, resourcing, and operational effectiveness
* Help create accountability across the studio by following up on open items, pushing decisions forward, and keeping workstreams moving


**Client \& Project Leadership**
* Serve as a senior point of contact for clients and help manage relationships across active work
* Navigate project conversations across scope, contracts, design, technical coordination, and delivery
* Step into difficult project situations and help resolve issues with sound judgment and a broad understanding of project needs
* Balance design intent, technical requirements, coordination demands, and client expectations across the life of a project


**Contracts, Technical Oversight \& CA**
* Engage directly in contract review, contract language discussions, and related project risk items as needed
* Provide high\-level oversight on technical issues and support teams in resolving project coordination challenges
* Participate in CA\-related discussions and help ensure project issues are being surfaced and addressed appropriately
* Act as a senior escalation point when projects need broader leadership attention beyond pure design questions


**Team Leadership**
* Help supervise and support team members working across design, project delivery, and technical execution
* Provide oversight and direction to staff who need support coordinating clients, internal standards, and changing project demands
* Mentor team members and help reinforce expectations for accountability, communication, and cross\-functional coordination
* Work closely with leadership to identify where additional supervision or stronger management coverage is needed


**Benefits**
* Hybrid work schedule: four days in\-office, one day remote
* Comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, and vision)
* Paid time off and holidays
* Professional development opportunities
* A collaborative, innovative work environment with a supportive culture focused on mentorship and growth


***Compensation:***
*Commensurate with experience and scope of leadership responsibility. The salary range for this role is $140,000\-$170,000\.*

title: Associate Applied (AI) Value Engineer (Nordics) - Orbit Program

As an Applied (AI) Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business\-critical problems for our customers. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world's leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12\-month Orbit Program.



During the Orbit Graduate program, you will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis.



Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands\-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. You will gain expertise in:

* Scoping business and technical requirements

* Delivering impactful presentations and demos

* Excellent academic performance

**Bonus Points:**

* Customer\-facing, customer success/service, or sales experience.
* Hands\-on experience with technical Proof of Concept projects

title: Senior Concept Artist
description:

description:
#### **About Stark**


Stark builds the world’s most powerful electric motorcycles. From the VARG MX to the road\-legal VARG EX \& SM, our bikes have won world championships and are engineered to outperform anything with a combustion engine.


We’re based in Sant Boi, Barcelona, growing fast (77% year\-on\-year), and building a team that will take us even further. If you want to work on a product that people are genuinely obsessed with, this is it.


Stark will become the global market leader in premium motorcycles. Building premium motorcycles requires innovation and we need your help to make us succeed


Our mission is to lead the way towards a sustainable motorcycle industry, by reducing plastic and CO2 pollution.


This will be achieved by building sustainable products that are superior to traditional technology in terms of Performance, Emotion and Design.

#### **The Role**


This isn't just a procurement role; it is a strategic position requiring a deep understanding of the global electronics ecosystem. You will be responsible for navigating the complexities of semiconductor cycles, managing relationships with top\-tier manufacturers, and identifying technical opportunities within our designs to optimize the supply chain.

title: Electrical Project Manager
description:
Mercury is the European leader in construction solutions.



We build and manage complex engineering \& construction projects for the world’s leading corporations. Our solutions help deliver technologies and life changing advancements that connect people, communities, and businesses, giving them the power to achieve incredible things. Our people have the courage to be innovative. Their determination and sharp focus enable us to deliver with certainty, time and time again.



We deliver our clients’ visions through leading edge construction solutions across multiple sectors, including Enterprise Data Centres, Advanced Technology \& Life Sciences, Hyperscale Data Centres, Fire Protection.



At Mercury, it is our duty to encourage and back our people to realise their vision of themselves. We place them at the heart of what we do, providing challenging opportunities to develop within a great team in a supportive environment that allows them to reach their full potential.

  


**Key Responsibilities of the Role:**


* Management of the Electrical Systems package and leadership of all electrical construction activities on site.
* Management of the OFCI / Main Capital electrical equipment and packages.
* Management of all day\-to\-day site operations relating to the electrical scope and interfaces with other trades.
* Ensure Mercury policies and procedures are followed closely.
* Familiarisation with Design/IFC specifications and drawings to fully understand the scope of the project works.
* Management of Site Safety in conjunction with the Project Manager and the Mercury Safety Advisor, including the setup, management and closing out of the safety file as part of the Management team.
* Ensure all work activities are planned to the required level of detail, with all documentation in line with company SOPs (RAMS, SPAs, Permits) and approved at the workface.
* Ensure all work is delivered in accordance with the permitting requirements of Mercury's Electrical Safety Rules and all applicable Safe Systems of Work.
* Ensure compliance with COHE and the Operating \& Energisation Procedures for LV \& MV systems, including arc flash awareness and controls.
* Oversee the room permits process and ensure contractors on site are compliant with requirements.
* Drive a focused Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental (QEHS) culture within your team and subcontractors, and drive the Mercury Engineering culture of safety and quality through the project.
* Ensure all EHS alerts are communicated effectively and understood by the team, and engage in campaigns including TBTs, stand\-downs, demonstrations and safety initiatives.
* Issue weekly safety stats and project labour projections.
* Management of Site QA in conjunction with the Mercury QA Manager, including set up, management and close out of the QA file, and review of contractor QAQC documentation and site performance.
* Ensure works are installed in accordance with project specifications and to the Project QA plan (e.g. pre\-agreed benchmarking).
* Review drawings and setting\-out details.
* Review quality of output and foster a culture of continuous improvement, implementing corrective actions where required.
* Manage and oversee the quality inspection regime, ensuring subcontractors carry out and maintain all quality inspections, ITPs, RFTs and snag closure as part of their scope, and hold them accountable for completing and submitting these on time and in line with the Project QA plan.
* Management of the electrical design process in conjunction with the Design Manager.
* Oversee the coordination process to transform design information into full installation drawings via BIM personnel, ensuring spec compliance and schedule priority.
* Manage the generation and close\-out of RFIs and technical queries, value engineering initiatives and design risk management.
* Management of the Project Schedule in conjunction with the Mercury Project Manager, Planner, consulting Engineer and Client requirements, including weekly progress updates.
* Ensure all site works are planned according to site production control requirements (Visilean or other collaborative planning).
* Drive digital collaborative planning and Lean construction processes to ensure effective coordination, efficient execution of works and timely delivery of milestones.
* Use project lookaheads to drive delivery and resource planning.
* Schedule material deliveries to correspond with the project schedule and track all deliveries.
* Management of all costs associated with your package including: Mercury Electrical Team; Sub\-contractors; Material deliveries and goods receipting; Plant and Equipment; Variations; Valuations.
* Own the commercial performance of the package, ensuring timely identification, management and recovery of variations, claims and commercial risks.
* Ensure subcontractor invoicing is measured in accordance with agreed progress milestones.
* Ensure Material Take\-Offs (MTOs) are completed and reviewed against subcontractor pricing returns and procurement budgets.
* Prepare Sub\-contract and Supplier Tender Packages in conjunction with the Project QS.
* Ensure subcontractors used have been vetted and approved by Mercury Procurement before use.
* Issue weekly cost reports, including all orders placed, materials expected and labour levels.
* Management of sub\-contractor activities including tracking progress against schedule and manpower levels. Ensure there is a weekly minuted meeting with sub\-contractors.
* Monitor that subcontractors have sufficiently resourced the project to maintain programme delivery.
* Management of the Mercury "In Progress" snagging system, ensuring supervisors return weekly punch lists where applicable, and ensure all snags are distributed to and closed out by all sub\-contractors.
* Maintain an active risk register and implement mitigation measures, highlighting any risk elements within Mercury's control (e.g. late deliveries).
* Implement the Mercury Project Audit Plan, review weekly audits and address open items with your team.
* Drive closure of all open audit actions within agreed timelines and communicate findings clearly to all stakeholders.
* Capture and act on lessons learned.
* Issue direct labour hours and sub\-contractor hours to the time administrator for tracking centrally.
* Issue an internal weekly progress report rolled up from project supervisors' reports, highlighting percentage complete based on WBS codes and any concerns or risks within Mercury's control.
* Issue an external weekly progress report to the Project Manager, highlighting areas not available, delays, shortage of design, third\-party hold\-ups and percentage complete.
* Attendance at Site Meetings, Internal Project Reviews, Engineering Reviews, Planning and Co\-ordination Meetings and Handover Meetings.
* Attend morning whiteboard meetings and evening planning/schedule review meetings.
* Maintain a weekly project photographic diary.
* Support and coach all the electrical team to ensure their development, which is crucial to our organisation and industry, supporting succession planning and team development.
* Set training requirements for Mercury and subcontractor staff and ensure appropriate training is available and completed.
* Direct management of the Mercury Engineering project team, including alignment of all discipline leads to the benefit of project goals.
* Drive the commissioning of all electrical equipment, taking ownership of completing the Red Tag (L2A – Installation) and Yellow Tag (L2B – Ready for Energisation) with all checklists and test documentation uploaded and approved in CxDE, then support the final commissioning levels — L3 Start\-Up (Green Tag), L4 Functional Performance Testing and Integrated System Testing (IST) — ensuring the electrical team and subcontractors deliver each level on time, to the required quality, and to CxA sign\-off.
* Close out of all project items including Final Account, O \& M Manuals, Punch List, Safety File, QA File, Material and Plant re\-locations and Project Plan – all with the support of the site Project Manager and your project team.
* All other duties associated with the role.

  


**Essential Criteria for the Role:**

* Overall 10\-15\+ years of experience in the construction sector.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Electrical, construction management, or other relevant degree.
* Minimum 5 years previous experience in Project Management
* Proven record of coordinating and managing large installation projects
* Experience dealing with Industrial Relations issues
* Knowledge of Health \& Safety
* Experienced in design and build
* Good technical knowledge of both Electrical and Mechanical systems
* Excellent IT skills
* Excellent communication skills
* Ability to work well within strict deadlines
* Ability to drive a large\-scale project

  


***Mercury is an equal opportunities employer*****.**

  


**Gerente de proyectos eléctricos**

  



Mercury es el líder europeo en soluciones para la construcción.



Diseñamos y gestionamos proyectos complejos de ingeniería y construcción para las corporaciones líderes a nivel mundial. Nuestras soluciones ayudan a ofrecer tecnologías y avances transformadores que conectan a personas, comunidades y empresas, dándoles el poder de lograr cosas increíbles. Nuestra gente tiene el coraje de ser innovadora. Su determinación y su gran capacidad de concentración nos permiten cumplir con certeza, una y otra vez.



Hacemos realidad las visiones de nuestros clientes mediante soluciones de construcción de vanguardia en múltiples sectores, incluidos centros de datos empresariales, tecnología avanzada y ciencias de la vida, centros de datos a hiperescala y protección contra incendios.

**Principales responsabilidades del puesto:**


* Gestión del paquete de sistemas eléctricos y dirección de todas las actividades de construcción eléctrica en la obra.
* Gestión de los equipos y paquetes eléctricos de OFCI / Capital Principal.
* Gestión de todas las operaciones diarias en la obra relacionadas con el ámbito eléctrico y la coordinación con otros oficios.
* Asegúrese de que se sigan estrictamente las políticas y los procedimientos de Mercury.
* Familiarizarse con las especificaciones y los planos de diseño/IFC para comprender plenamente el alcance de los trabajos del proyecto.
* Gestión de la seguridad en obra en colaboración con el director del proyecto y el asesor de seguridad de Mercury, incluyendo la configuración, gestión y cierre del expediente de seguridad como parte del equipo directivo.
* Asegúrese de que todas las actividades laborales estén planificadas con el nivel de detalle requerido, con toda la documentación en conformidad con los SOP de la empresa (RAMS, SPA, permisos) y aprobada en el lugar de trabajo.
* Asegúrese de que todo el trabajo se realice de acuerdo con los requisitos de permisos de las Normas de Seguridad Eléctrica de Mercury y todos los Sistemas de Trabajo Seguros aplicables.
* Garantizar el cumplimiento de la normativa COHE y de los procedimientos de operación y energización para sistemas de baja y media tensión, incluyendo la concienciación y los controles sobre el riesgo de arco eléctrico.
* Supervisar el proceso de obtención de permisos para las salas y garantizar que los contratistas en obra cumplan con los requisitos.

* Asegúrese de que las obras se instalen de acuerdo con las especificaciones del proyecto y el plan de control de calidad del proyecto (por ejemplo, la evaluación comparativa previamente acordada).

title: Marketing Director
description:
About Graitec Group:

Graitec is a global leader in Building Information Modeling (BIM) solutions, designing and developing software that helps architects, engineers, and manufacturers design smarter and better. With over 30 years of innovation and an entrepreneurial spirit, we’ve tripled our revenue in just five years.

  

Our North Star is clear — accelerate the digital transformation of the AECO industry and model the future. We achieve this by growing our recurring revenue through innovative software and services that drive adoption, integration, and lasting value for our customers.

  

Our 800 experts across 30\+ offices in 12 countries support more than 270,000 users worldwide. As a global Autodesk Platinum Partner, we combine world\-class partnerships with our own cutting\-edge software and services to drive performance and sustainability across the industry.

  

At Graitec, we move fast and think big. We collaborate across teams and borders, embrace diversity, and challenge ourselves to innovate every day. We believe in doing the right thing, breaking down silos, and making an impact together.

 **How we work:** Growth, Agility, Innovation, Responsibility  

**How we behave:** Ambition, Engagement, One Graitec, Positive Energy  

**Learn more about the Graitec Group:** graitec\-group.com/graitec\-a\-global\-player


About the Team Hiring:

The Campaign Execution team is the operational engine of Graitec's Growth Marketing function. We translate marketing strategy into always\-on, measurable programs that generate pipeline and drive revenue across 13 countries. The team spans marketing automation, content, email execution, program operations, and global campaign delivery.

  

Graitec is 40 years old and moving faster than ever. We are transitioning from a leading Autodesk reseller into a global IP software company — and marketing is central to that transformation. We have brand presence, a large customer base, and a growing product portfolio. What we need now is the execution infrastructure to convert that into predictable, scalable pipeline.

  

This role exists because we are ready to move beyond campaigns. We run programs — launches, events, seasonal pushes — and we run them well. But we have not yet built the always\-on growth engine that compounds over time: the lifecycle programs that never stop nurturing, the automation plays that respond to buyer signals in real time, and the performance loop that tells us what to scale and what to cut. That is what this Director helps build.


Overview:
* The Marketing Director (Global Campaign Execution) builds and leads the global marketing execution engine that converts audience engagement into qualified pipeline — evolving Graitec from discrete campaigns to always\-on, AI\-enabled growth programs that compound over time.
* Reporting to the VP, Global Growth Marketing, the Director leads a team of five and partners across Growth Marketing, Corporate Marketing, Solutions Marketing, SDR, Sales, and Revenue Operations. The VP sets strategy and organizational direction; this role owns the always\-on execution engine and is accountable for its pipeline contribution.

 **Always\-On Growth Engine:**

* In partnership with the VP, help drive the transition from building campaigns from scratch each quarter to running programs that are always on — spending team time improving what works rather than restarting from zero.
* Design and build full\-funnel lifecycle programs — acquisition, activation, expansion, retention — that run continuously and compound over time.
* Manage the operating model within the strategic direction set by the VP — campaign frameworks, channel mix execution, audience segmentation, and the feedback loops that drive optimization  

Use AI tools to accelerate personalization, content generation, campaign testing, and performance analysis at scale.

 **Campaign Orchestration \& Pipeline Acceleration:**

* Execute against campaign strategy set by the VP and Corporate and Solutions Marketing — translating strategy into activated, multi\-channel programs.
* Drive the campaign calendar, production timelines, and cross\-functional coordination across Growth Marketing, SDR, and Sales.
* Lead pipeline acceleration programs — ABM plays, nurture sequences, and SDR\-aligned follow\-up strategies — that move opportunities through the funnel.
* Identify the highest\-performing campaign motions, build the case to scale them, and present recommendations to the VP for approval.

 **Marketing Automation, Data \& Technology:**

* Own the global marketing automation platform as a revenue system — not a broadcast tool — ensuring it operates with precision, segmentation, and measurable impact.
* Drive lead scoring, routing logic, nurture architecture, and CRM data quality in close collaboration with Revenue Operations.
* Implement the first\-party data strategy set by the VP — enabling signal\-based, personalized marketing at scale.
* Evaluate and recommend AI\-powered marketing tools that improve targeting accuracy, content relevance, and campaign efficiency.

 **Performance Reporting \& Revenue Visibility:**

* Own marketing's performance narrative — pipeline attribution, campaign ROI, funnel conversion, and lifecycle metrics — reported to the VP and broader leadership on a regular cadence.
* Build the dashboards and data infrastructure that give leadership real\-time visibility into marketing's contribution to revenue.
* Drive a culture of measurement, rapid experimentation, and evidence\-based decision\-making across the team.

 **Partner \& Co\-Marketing Programs:**

* Lead Autodesk MDF/MDP co\-marketing strategy and execution — moving from compliance reporting to strategic pipeline generation.
* Develop co\-marketing campaigns that integrate with the broader campaign calendar and are measured against pipeline contribution.

 **Team Leadership \& Organizational Development:**

* Lead, develop, and elevate a team of five — setting high standards for execution quality, accountability, and strategic contribution.
* Build a team culture where feedback loops are fast, testing is the norm, and performance is visible and celebrated.
* Develop each team member's capability over time, moving the team from executors to strategic contributors.

 **The Team:**

  

You will lead five direct reports spanning automation, content, program operations, and campaign execution:

* **Campaign Marketing Manager** — Global campaign execution, Italian market, Autodesk MDF/MDP co\-marketing.
* **Marketing Automation Manager** — Global automation platform, nurture architecture, lead scoring and routing.
* **Content Specialist** — Blog publishing, web content, editorial calendar execution.
* **Marketing Programs Manager** — Campaign operations, project management, product line and regional activation.
* **Email Execution Specialist** — Campaign build and deployment, platform operations, list management.

  

This is an execution\-strong team with room to grow strategically. Your job is to raise the ceiling.

 **Key Partners:**

* **Corporate Marketing** — Campaign strategy, core content, brand direction
* **Solutions Marketing** — Product positioning, messaging, GTM strategy
* **Digital Marketing** — SEO/GEO, paid media, analytics, web performance
* **Events \& Community** — Regional events, community programs, field activation
* **SDR Practice** — Lead qualification, pipeline acceleration, outbound plays
* **Sales** — Pipeline alignment, deal acceleration, win/loss insight
* **Revenue Operations** — Attribution, data governance, pipeline definitions, reporting

 **Business Purpose \& Value Contribution:**

  

Graitec is at an inflection point. In the last four years we doubled in size. In the next few years, we intend to do it again — this time driven by our own software, not just the products we resell. This Director role sits at the center of that ambition: if marketing gets this right, pipeline becomes predictable, sales cycles shorten, and the brand shifts in the market.

  

The role converts marketing strategy into revenue outcomes. It is accountable for the infrastructure — programs, automation, data, and reporting — that makes marketing's contribution to pipeline visible, repeatable, and scalable across all 13 countries.

  

You will work in a flat, entrepreneurial environment where leaders have real ownership — not a committee for every decision. You will have access to a team ready to grow, a VP who thinks strategically and removes obstacles, and a transformation story that is genuinely compelling in the market.

 **Key Outcomes Expected:**

  

Performance is reviewed quarterly against pipeline and revenue contribution, campaign effectiveness, and the team's progression toward an always\-on operating model. Annual targets are set in partnership with the VP, Global Growth Marketing and Revenue Operations.

 **Pipeline \& Revenue:**

* Marketing\-sourced pipeline ($ and %)
* Marketing\-influenced pipeline
* MQL to SQL to Opportunity conversion rates
* Pipeline velocity

 **Campaign Performance:**

* Pipeline generated per campaign
* Campaign ROI and cost per opportunity
* Engagement rates by channel
* Channel efficiency benchmarks

 **Lifecycle \& Retention:**

* Nurture\-to\-opportunity rate
* Time\-to\-conversion by stage
* Lead recycling effectiveness
* Churn influence via retention plays

 **Operational Excellence:**

* Campaign launch consistency
* Attribution model accuracy
* Automation platform adoption
* Data quality and database health

 **What Success looks like at 12 Months:**

* The team is running always\-on programs — key lifecycle and demand programs are live, being optimized continuously, and not rebuilt from scratch each quarter.
* Marketing has a clear, trusted pipeline attribution model — leadership and Sales agree on the numbers, and they are reported in real time.
* The Campaign Execution team is viewed as a strategic pipeline partner by Sales and SDR — not a service function that produces assets.
* AI tools are embedded in how the team works — accelerating personalization, content, testing, and reporting.
* Each team member has a clear development path and is operating at or above the expectations set for their role.
* Autodesk co\-marketing is generating measurable pipeline contribution, not just MDF compliance.


Responsibilities:
* 8–12 years in B2B marketing, with a majority of that time in demand generation, growth marketing, or campaign execution leadership.
* Demonstrated experience building always\-on marketing programs — lifecycle nurture, ABM, automated demand gen — that were measured against pipeline, not activity.
* Hands\-on proficiency with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot strongly preferred) and CRM systems (Salesforce).
* Proven change management experience — you have led a team or function through a meaningful operational transformation, not just inherited a working model.
* Experience working in B2B SaaS or subscription software — you understand recurring revenue, expansion motion, and the full customer lifecycle.
* AI fluency — you use AI tools actively in your marketing practice and have a point of view on how they change what's possible for a team like this.
* Strong data and analytics capability — you can build attribution models, interpret funnel data, and communicate revenue impact to senior stakeholders.
* Track record of global or multi\-region marketing leadership.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

 **Preferred Experience:**

* Experience in AEC, construction tech, engineering software, or a technical B2B vertical with long sales cycles.
* Familiarity with Autodesk partner co\-marketing programs (MDF/MDP).
* Revenue Operations alignment experience — working alongside RevOps on shared pipeline definitions, data governance, and reporting.
* Experience with intent data platforms, CDPs, or signal\-based marketing orchestration.

 **How You Lead:**

* You are a builder, not a maintainer — you see the gap between where things are and where they should be, and you close it.
* You lead with data and communicate with executive clarity — metrics tell you what to do, but you decide how to frame it for the room.
* You raise the floor on execution quality while raising the ceiling on strategic ambition.
* You operate at the intersection of strategy and operations without losing altitude on either end.
* You build trust quickly with peers in Sales, SDR, Solutions Marketing, and Corporate Marketing — you influence without authority as often as you direct.


Interview Process:

At Graitec, we’re proud to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace.

  

We value our employees for who they are and the contributions they bring, encouraging everyone to be their authentic selves at work. This diversity helps us better serve the wide range of customers and markets we operate in. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and assess candidates solely on their skills and ability to succeed in the role.

  

Graitec uses AI to support and streamline internal processes; however, all application reviews, screening, and hiring decisions are made solely by our Talent Acquisition team and hiring managers.

* **Final Interview** – Conversation with the Business Unit Leader

  

As a signatory of United Nations Women’s Empowerment Principles, Graitec is committed to equal opportunity and pay transparency.

Maximum Annual On Target Earning: 100K EUR

 **Note:** Salary range indicated in this add is for information only \& targeted for a specific seniority level and targeted location. Final salary offer might vary depending on final candidate location, seniority, competencies…

title: Excellence & Execution Head

You will anticipate market and ecosystem shifts, translate global strategies into impactful local execution, and continuously elevate execution standards through external benchmarking, innovation, and operational excellence.


You will lead a high\-performing organization spanning five core capabilities:

* Field Excellence
* Integrated Insights
* Data, Analytics \& Platforms (DAP)
* Capability Building
* Customer Excellence

  

Together, these teams enable superior execution, optimized resource allocation, enhanced customer experiences, and sustainable business performance across the portfolio.

### **Integrated Insights**

* Drive standardization of tools, processes, and data governance frameworks.
* Enable adoption of AI\-powered solutions and advanced analytics platforms.
* Manage business readiness and deployment of global execution excellence initiatives and technology platforms.
* Foster digital, technology, and AI capability development across the organization.

### **Capability Building**

* Build and deploy world\-class capabilities across Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs, and Value \& Access.
* Assess future capability requirements based on strategic priorities and evolving industry trends.
* Deliver impactful learning journeys, curricula, and development programs.
* Establish standards for learning governance, effectiveness measurement, and capability outcomes.
* Partner with global teams and external vendors to deliver innovative learning experiences.

### **Customer Excellence**

* Drive integrated customer engagement excellence across Commercial and Value \& Access organizations.
* Lead omnichannel strategy activation and customer journey optimization.
* Ensure launch readiness through robust planning, orchestration, execution, and continuous improvement processes.
* Optimize content deployment, customer engagement strategies, and promotional excellence frameworks.
* Coordinate congresses, strategic events, and customer engagement initiatives.
* Drive implementation of global frameworks including ICE, IpEx, and launch excellence programs.

### **Leadership \& Culture**

* Lead, inspire, and develop a diverse team of execution excellence professionals.
* Foster a high\-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Build strong succession pipelines and future leadership capabilities.
* Drive transformation through Novartis Leadership Expectations and a growth mindset culture.
* Role model the highest standards of ethics, integrity, compliance, and patient focus.

**Essential Requirements**
--------------------------

### **Education**

* University degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Biosciences, or a related field.
* Advanced degree preferred.

### **Experience**

* Extensive leadership experience (typically 12\+ years) within the pharmaceutical industry, consulting, FMCG, or related sectors.
* Proven track record leading commercial organizations, business transformation, or execution excellence functions.
* Experience working across multiple execution excellence capabilities such as analytics, field operations, customer excellence, digital transformation, capability building, or market insights.
* Demonstrated success leading complex change initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders without formal authority.
* Experience operating in highly matrixed, cross\-functional environments.

### **Skills \& Expertise**

* Advanced strategic thinking, analytical, forecasting, and insight\-generation capabilities.
* Expertise in digital transformation, technology adoption, AI enablement, and data\-driven decision\-making.

* Excellent project management, prioritization, and organizational effectiveness skills.
