Director of Planetary Health Alliance European Hub Secretariat
description:
The Barcelona Institute for Global Health (ISGlobal) is a cutting\-edge institute addressing global public health challenges through research, translation into policy and education. ISGlobal has a broad portfolio in communicable and non\-communicable diseases including environmental and climate determinants, and applies a multidisciplinary scientific approach ranging from the molecular to the population level. Research is organized in five programs: Climate, Air Pollution, Nature and Urban Health; Environment and Health over the Lifecourse; Global Viral and Bacterial Infections; Malaria and Neglected Parasitic Diseases and Maternal Child and Reproductive Health. ISGlobal is accredited with the Severo Ochoa distinction, a seal of excellence of the Spanish Science Ministry.


During the last years, ISGlobal has emerged as a prominent international advocate for Planetary Health approach, integrating human health and the health of our planet into actionable research and policy initiatives. Together with a cluster of institutions — Fundació Sanitària Mollet (FSM), Consell Assessor per al Desenvolupament Sostenible (CADS), Col·legi Oficial de Metges de Barcelona (CoMB), and Universitat Oberta de Catalunya (UOC) — ISGlobal has been appointed to lead the Secretariat of the Planetary Health Alliance European Regional Hub (European Hub of the Planetary Health Alliance) for the 2026–2028 term. The European Hub is part of the global Planetary Health Alliance and works closely with its global headquarters and regional hubs.

### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**


ISGlobal is seeking a senior professional to lead the development and coordination of the Planetary Health Alliance European Hub Secretariat.


The European Hub Lead will provide strategic and operational leadership, strengthen the European Planetary Health community and represent the Hub in its relations with PHA Global (hosted at Johns Hopkins University), European institutions, professional and academic networks, healthcare organizations, policymakers and civil society.


The role requires a strong capacity to connect scientific knowledge with institutional strategy, policy and implementation; to build interdisciplinary and cross\-sectoral partnerships; and to translate Planetary Health principles into collaborative initiatives with tangible impact.


The position involves regular interaction with European and international organizations and occasional travel within Europe.

### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the Secretariat of the PHA European Regional Hub Secretariat as a multiinstituional cluster.
* Lead the implementation of the European Hub strategy and work plan for the 2026–2028 term including the search of funding opportunities
* Ensure alignment and close partnership with PHA Global and maintain regular collaboration with other regional hubs.
* Strengthen and expand the Planetary Health network across Europe.
* Build strategic partnerships with academic institutions, healthcare organizations, public administrations, professional bodies, European networks and civil society.
* Facilitate interdisciplinary and intersectoral collaboration among Hub members and partners.
* Represent the European Hub at European and international meetings, conferences and institutional forums.
* Contribute and oversee the Hub’s communication and dissemination strategy, including its website, newsletters and professional networks.
* Communicate Planetary Health concepts and initiatives effectively to scientific, institutional, professional and public audiences.

**AUXILIAR TASKS**


This job description reflects the present requirements of the post but may evolve at any time in the future as duties and responsibilities change and/or develop providing there is appropriate consultation with the post\-holder.


This job description is not a definitive or exhaustive list of responsibilities but identifies the key responsibilities and tasks of the post holder. The specific objectives of the post holder will be subject to review as part of the individual professional assessment process.

### **SKILLS**

* Strategic vision and strong leadership capacity.
* Excellent stakeholder engagement, facilitation and relationship\-management skills.
* Ability to work across disciplines, sectors and institutional cultures.
* Strong planning, coordination and decision\-making abilities.
* Excellent written and oral communication, including public speaking and institutional representation.
* Capacity to work autonomously while fostering collaborative and distributed leadership.
* Proactive, innovative and results\-oriented approach.
* Ability to identify strategic partnerships, project opportunities and potential funding sources.
* Availability for occasional travel within Europe.


The post holder will adhere to ISGlobal principles contained in **People management policy, including Equity, diversity and health safety**. The post holder will respect, and be accountable to ensure ISGlobal policies and procedures.

### **TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE / QUALIFICATIONS**

* University degree in environmental sciences, public health, health sciences, sustainability or another relevant discipline.
* Postgraduate training in Planetary Health, environmental health, public health, sustainability, management or a related field will be considered an asset.
* At least ten years of relevant professional experience in environmental health, sustainability, public health, Planetary Health or related fields.
* Demonstrated experience leading strategic programmes, organizational transformation or multi\-stakeholder initiatives.
* Proven ability to develop partnerships across academic, healthcare, institutional, policy and civil\-society settings.
* Experience translating scientific and technical knowledge into strategies, programmes, policies or practical solutions.
* Experience working in European or international networks and representing organizations in high\-level professional environments.
* Knowledge of health\-system transformation, environmental determinants of health and Planetary Health approaches will be highly valued.

### **LANGUAGE LEVEL**

* Full professional proficiency in English, Spanish and Catalan, both written and spoken.
* Knowledge of additional European languages will be considered an asset.

### **CONDITIONS**

* Contract: Full time (40 hours per week). Until the end of the European Hub’s current mandate in December 2028\.
* Salary: According to ISGlobal internal salary scale
* Work\-Life Balance: 36 days off per year (23 vacation days \+ 13 personal days)
* Start date: September 2026

### **HOW TO APPLY**


Applicants must complete the application form and upload a CV and a Cover Letter. Each document must be clearly named with the candidate’s name and surname.


Applications will remain open until 16th of September.


Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and shortlisted candidates may be contacted and interviewed as applications are received. Interviews may take place during the application period.


We encourage diverse applications, including but not limited to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, age, sexual orientation, physical abilities, and political beliefs.

### **SELECTION PROCESS**


The selection process is designed in two phases:
  

1\- Interview phase of a technical nature, with the team that requires the incorporation. To assess the person's skills and CV.  

2 \- Meeting with HR with the finalist(s) to finish assessing the profile and discuss contractual and institutional issues.


If needed any technical test could be passed. A Psychological Competency Evaluation Test will be required for the structural or transversal positions.


In accordance with the OTM\-R principles, a gender\-balanced recruitment panel is formed for every vacancy at the beginning of the process. After reviewing the content of the applications, the panel will start the interviews, with at least one technical and one administrative interview. A profile questionnaire as well as a technical exercise may be required during the process.

Industry Alignment: Proven track record working with Fast\-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), supply chain companies, or closely related industries

Innovation \& Problem Solving: Demonstrated success innovating across complex business processes and technical solutions using critical thinking  


Communication \& Influence

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
-------------------

**ABOUT CONTEXT TRAVEL**


Context Travel is a global day tour operator that connects intellectually curious travelers with local subject matter experts in over 60 destinations around the world. Our guests often tell us that we are the best part of their trip, and we take great pride in creating unforgettable moments that are treasured for a lifetime.


Context is a long\-standing company founded in 2003\. We have been backed by growth equity since 2017\.

**ROLE:** Regional Senior Associate \- Italy, Southern Europe and Africa  

**LOCATION:** Remote role  

**SCHEDULE**: Monday\-Friday, 9:00 AM \- 6:00 PM CET  

**SALARY:** Commensurate with experience

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
-------------------


Context’s Delivery team ensures the seamless execution of exceptional cultural experiences for all stakeholders—clients, travel advisors, guides, vendors, venues, and partners. We create highly personalized experiences while maintaining smooth and efficient operations.


The **Regional Senior Associate \- Italy, Southern Europe and Africa** is a key member of the Italy, Southern Europe, Africa Delivery team. This is a hybrid commercial and operational role. You will own high\-value custom requests from first enquiry to confirmed booking, and you will hold deep knowledge of the regional portfolio. The role has two equal halves. The first is client\-facing and commercial: converting custom enquiries, advising clients and advisors, and maximizing the value of each booking. The second is behind the scenes: keeping the regional portfolio accurate and fulfillable, working directly with our experts, and using data and tools to improve our regional operations.  

  

The role reports to the Regional Senior Manager \- Italy, Southern Europe and Africa, and will work closely with the Regional Director and the Regional Delivery team.

**ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------

* Own the end\-to\-end journey for custom and high\-value regional requests, from initial qualification and proposal design to closing the sale and identifying upsell opportunities.
* Serve as the primary, proactive contact for clients and advisors, ensuring all proposals are commercially sound, operationally feasible, and accurately tracked.
* Maintain expert knowledge of the ISEA portfolio to ensure fulfillability, support product development, and turn recurring custom requests into repeatable products.
* Monitor backend configurations and flag seasonality risks or portfolio gaps before they impact bookings.
* Manage 1:1 expert communications and build trusted relationships with the regional community, thoughtfully matching experts to clients based on context and expertise.
* Provide clear briefings on custom content and collect expert feedback to drive continuous product improvement.
* Triage the regional inbox daily by urgency and value, maintaining strict data hygiene through consistent tagging and accurate information transfer.
* Maintain communication templates and canned responses to ensure high\-quality, reportable regional data.
* Analyze regional trends and root causes to identify client and operational pain points, providing actionable recommendations for cross\-functional resolution.
* Fluently utilize the tech stack and AI tools to optimize drafting, research, and data tasks, sharing best practices with the team.
* Design, document, and lead new regional workflows and efficiency projects to improve the overall client experience.
* Mentor and train seasonal contractors and Delivery colleagues.
* Support onboarding of new regional teammates and act as a resource for best practice.
* Actively contribute to weekly Delivery team and cross\-regional meetings.
* Participate in region\-agnostic initiatives and lead project working groups.

**KEY STRENGTHS AND IMPACT AREAS**
----------------------------------

* **Commercial instinct.** Converts custom enquiries into confirmed, profitable bookings without losing the personal touch.
* **Portfolio depth.** Knows the Italian, Greek, Turkey and Africa product well enough to answer most questions without escalating.
* **Technical fluency.** Adopts tools, including AI, and turns them into time saved for the whole team.
* **Data discipline.** Tags, records, and reports accurately, so regional decisions are based on real numbers.
* **Pattern recognition.** Sees the trend behind the individual complaint and proposes the structural fix.
* **Expert relationships.** Trusted by the expert community, and able to brief them well under time pressure.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**
---------------------

**Required**

* 2\+ of experience in travel, hospitality, or a comparable client\-facing commercial role.
* Proven experience selling or building custom, high\-value travel or service proposals with an eagerness to close the sale and celebrate the win
* Native\-level English and Italian written and spoken (required), with strong professional judgement in sensitive client and expert\-facing communications
* Deep familiarity with and passion for Italy (required), including 3\+ years lived or directly relevant professional experience, with a knack for inspiring others to visit.
* Demonstrated autonomous ownership: can triage, decide, and close loops without heavy supervision.Sincere enthusiasm for connecting with clients both via email and over the phone
* Confident with CRM, booking, and communication platforms; fast to learn new systems.
* Comfortable working with data: building a report, reading it, and explaining what it means.
* You are someone who does not stop at the task in front of them. This person spots patterns, brings them to the team, and proposes the process or the tool that fixes the problem for good. Comfort with technology — including AI tools — is central to the role, not a nice to have.
* Resilience and composure—you handle unhappy clients with empathy and a thick skin
* Cultural sensitivity—you have experience and/or interest in working with colleagues and people from around the globe
* A curious, learning\-driven mindset—you’d happily be one of our clients yourself

**Preferred**

* Knowledge of Greece or other Southern Europe destinations.
* Greek or another regional language.
* Experience writing SOPs or training material.
* Background in cultural heritage, art history, archaeology, or a related field.

**In exchange, we are thrilled to offer:**

* Unlimited access to digital lectures and, audio guides, and in\-person small group tours

* An annual company retreat to connect and celebrate with colleagues in person. (Past locations include New York City, Philadelphia, Lisbon, Barcelona, Mexico City, and Berlin. In 2024 we took the whole company to our birthplace, Rome, to celebrate our 20th anniversary.)

description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

**About the role**
------------------


Productions is the 'done for you' managed services wing of ElevenLabs made for creators and media businesses. We bring together our AI audio tools and human experts to unlock human\-edited dubs, audiobooks, and more in 15\+ languages directly on the ElevenLabs platform.

**Here are a few recent projects Productions has helped bring to life:**
------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Dubbing for some of the world's biggest creators (DudePerfect, Lex Fridman, Andrew Huberman), media businesses (Headspace) **and broadcasters (Mediaset)**
* Audiobook production for leading publishers and digital storytelling platforms
* Voice creation, sound design, and other audio engineering services for ElevenLabs' largest customers
* You can learn more about Productions here: https://elevenlabs.io/productions

**As a Production Manager, you drive the success of Productions for one or multiple language teams, including:**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Onboarding and training linguists and other audio professionals (Producers) to use the ElevenLabs platform
* Building quality control and monitoring systems for your language to ensure the dubs, audiobooks, and other content we deliver sound natural and professional\-grade
* Working with the Productions product and engineering team to optimize our tools and processes for high\-quality content creation
* Define our editorial line and set our creative direction, such as style guides, voice casting, translation and adaptation principles

**Requirements**
----------------


While we don’t require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees, the following will set you apart as a candidate for a Production Manager role:

* **Native speaker of or native\-level knowledge** of Arabic.
* **Experience building and/or running a production team** inside a language service provider (LSP), localization agency, media company, or similar for one or multiple of the following:


	+ Transcripts
	+ Translations
	+ Dubs
	+ Audiobooks
* **Strong attention to detail**: you should have keen eyes and ears in your native language and be capable of spotting even the smallest inconsistencies or mistakes that keep something from reading or sounding 100% natural.
* **Comfortable giving feedback:** you will be responsible for the quality of content the team produces in your language and should feel comfortable setting and maintaining a high bar.
* Bonus points for:


	+ Familiarity with the ElevenLabs platform, including our transcript editor, Studio, and dubbing products
	+ Native\-level abilities in multiple non\-English languages

**Location**
------------


This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.


\#LI\-Remote

We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

title: Key Leader | Operaciones de Producto
description:
Qui som
  
  

lululemon és una empresa innovadora de roba d'alt rendiment per fer ioga, córrer, entrenar i practicar altres esports. Posem el llistó alt amb teixits tècnics i un disseny funcional, i creem experiències i productes transformadors que ajuden les persones a moure's, créixer, connectar i estar en forma. El nostre èxit el devem als productes innovadors que confeccionem, a l'èmfasi en les botigues, al compromís amb el nostre personal i a les connexions increïbles que fem allà on anem. Com a empresa, ens centrem a crear un canvi positiu i construir un futur més sa i pròsper. Particularment, això inclou crear un ambient equitatiu, inclusiu i centrat en el creixement per al nostre personal.
  
  

**Resum del càrrec:**  

El càrrec de líder d'equip és una part essencial de l'equip de lideratge de la botiga, ja que impacta en l'experiència diària dels membres de l'equip de la planta i dels clients. Els líders d'equip són responsables de donar exemple i suport als formadors, tot facilitant una experiència excellent per als clients i supervisant totes les operacions de la planta de vendes. Els líders d'equip utilitzen les mètriques i els indicadors clau de rendiment per prioritzar les responsabilitats alhora que s'adapten a les operacions comercials i els reptes del dia a dia.
  
  

Responsabilitats claus del càrrec
  
  

Lideratge i gestió del personal
  
  

* Donar suport en relació amb la formació i el desenvolupament continus dels membres de l'equip, tot proporcionant comentaris, assessorament, formació i orientació professional directes i abordant les preocupacions de l'equip.
* Oferir reconeixement als membres de l'equip, avaluar les deficiències i proporcionar documentació de rendiment general per donar suport i reforçar la carrera professional i el creixement personal de l'equip.
* Desenvolupar, mantenir i difondre el coneixement general de l'empresa i dels productes a través dels canals de comunicació apropiats.


Experiència del client
  
  

* Liderar l'equip de la botiga, la qual cosa inclou planificar la cobertura de la planta i prendre decisions per mantenir el rendiment i l'eficàcia de les operacions de la botiga.
* Donar suport als membres de l'equip (per exemple, tot donant exemple o assessorant\-los) per garantir una experiència fantàstica per al client que demostri que valorem el seu temps, la qual cosa inclou valorar les necessitats dels clients, proporcionar informació tècnica dels productes i ajudar en les transaccions a les botigues i els programes omnicanal (per exemple, les opcions de comprar en línia i recollir a la botiga, vendes per telèfon i enviament des de la botiga).
* Interactuar amb els clients i satisfer\-ne les necessitats per ajudar\-los i proporcionar\-los experiències de compra i de retorns efectives i personalitzades.
* Oferir informació tècnica sobre els productes tot explicant\-ne el valor i els beneficis.
* Solucionar problemes amb clients i compartir les queixes amb els superiors per fer "correccions" per als clients.
* Moure's amb dinamisme per la planta per avaluar i satisfer les necessitats del negoci, de l'equip i dels clients.


Treballar en equip
  
  

* Contribuir a un entorn de feina respectuós i inclusiu, on s'accepten i se celebren les diferències, per garantir que tant els membres de l'equip com els clients tinguin una experiència favorable i interessant.
* Establir relacions de suport i productives amb tots els membres de l'equip.
* Collaborar amb els membres de l'equip per garantir una experiència del client òptima i ajudar amb les operacions de la botiga.


Operacions
  
  

* Revisar les dades i les mètriques del negoci per avaluar el progrés dels objectius i determinar si s'han de fer ajustaments.
* Obrir i tancar la botiga d'acord amb les llistes de verificació d'obertura i tancament de la botiga.
* Gestionar les tasques de presentació del producte (p. ex., tornar a lloc els productes, reomplir o afegir articles esgotats a la planta de l'inventari, reduir l'estoc o tornar a collocar articles) segons els estàndards de l'empresa.
* Assignar tasques de neteja als formadors quan sigui necessari durant el torn per mantenir l'ambient luxós de la botiga.
* Assegurar\-se que l'equip utilitza la tecnologia de la botiga per contribuir a les operacions de la botiga i proporcionar una experiència positiva per als clients.
* Entendre i seguir les polítiques i els procediments de seguretat del personal per mantenir un entorn de treball segur.
* Treballar d'acord amb les polítiques, els procediments, les lleis i les regulacions aplicables.


Responsabilitat dels pressupostos
  
  

* No correspon


Gestió del personal
  
  

* Líder de l'equip indirectament responsable del subconjunt del personal de la botiga o segons ho delegui el gerent de botiga.


Habilitats clau i valors essencials que pots aportar
  
  

* Inclusió i diversitat: Crea/dona suport a un entorn inclusiu que valora/celebra les diferències.
* Integritat i honradesa: Actua de manera honesta, justa i ètica.
* Experiència dels clients: Gaudeix de la feina i de connectar amb els clients, entendre'ls i ajudar\-los.
* Collaboració i treball en equip: Treballa de manera productiva i ajuda els altres treballadors a aconseguir objectius; busca collaborar i veure diferents perspectives.
* Lideratge: Pot i vol liderar, influir i inspirar altres persones. Motiva, enforteix, desenvolupa i dirigeix el personal durant la feina.
* Comunicació sincera: Aborda de manera oberta i constructiva els problemes (és a dir, parla amb franquesa)
* Presa de decisions: Usa la lògica i el raonament per avaluar alternatives i prendre decisions efectives i oportunes.


Requisits per al càrrec
  
  

Idoneïtat
  
  

* Estar autoritzat o autoritzada legalment a treballar al país on està situada la botiga.
* Tenir 18 anys o més.
* Tenir autorització per treballar i documentació relativa als requeriments legals nacionals (només a EMEA).
* Poder desplaçar\-se a la botiga assignada amb els seus propis medis de transport.


Disponibilitat
  
  

* Disponibilitat per treballar en horari flexible, la qual cosa inclou vespres, caps de setmana i festius.


Altres requisits
  
  

* Estar disposat o disposada a treballar com a part d'un equip i també de manera independent.
* Estar disposat o disposada a moure's per la botiga durant la major part del torn per ajudar els clients i fer una bona treball.
* Estar disposat o disposada a moure caixes que pesin fins a 13,6 kg.
* Estar disposat o disposada a treballar en un ambient amb llums brillants i música alta.


Experiència
  
  

* Experiència laboral


Altres aptituds (és a dir, es valoren positivament però no són imprescindibles)
  
  

* Educació: Títol de batxillerat, secundària o equivalent
* Educació: Títol de grau o equivalent
* Experiència: 1 any en una posició de lideratge en el sector de vendes o en botiga (no cal que sigui de supervisió o de gestió de personal)


Conforme al nostre propòsit, posa't en contacte amb nosaltres a accommodations@lululemon.com si tens dubtes sobre com adaptar les teves aptituds úniques als requisits d'aquest càrrec, tant si necessites alguna adaptació raonable com si no. En el correu electrònic que enviïs, inclou el títol del càrrec, la ubicació del lloc de feina i el tipus de pregunta o sollicitud.
  
  

Més enllà de la nòmina (avantatges i beneficis)
  
  

A lululemon ens preocupem per les persones i invertim en tot el seu conjunt (cos, ment i ànima). El nostre programa de recompenses totals està dissenyat per ajudar\-te a aconseguir objectius i centrar\-te en allò que t'agrada. A part d'un salari base competitiu i un programa de bonificació basat en l'equip, també oferim amplis plans de salut, temps lliure remunerat, plans d'estalvi, grans descomptes per a empleats, classes de fitness/ioga, programes per ampliar la família i programes de desenvolupament personal i professional.
  
  

**Nota:** la disponibilitat d'aquests avantatges i beneficis pot estar subjecta a la ubicació i al tipus de feina, així com tenir requisits d'idoneïtat. L'empresa es reserva el dret d'alterar aquests avantatges i beneficis en la seva totalitat o de manera parcial en qualsevol moment i sense avís previ.
  
  

**Key Who We Are:**  

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth\-focused environment for our people.
  
  

**Job Summary:**  

The Key Leader role is an essential part of the store leadership team, impacting salesfloor team members and guest (i.e., customer) experience every day. Key Leaders are responsible for leading by example and providing support to Educators, facilitating an outstanding guest experience in the store, and overseeing all operations of the retail floor. Key Leaders leverage key performance indicators and metrics to prioritize responsibilities while adapting to day\-to\-day business adjustments and challenges.
  
  

Key Responsibilities of the Job
  
  

Leadership and People Management
  
  

* Support ongoing learning and development of team members by providing direct feedback, coaching, mentoring, and career path guidance, and addressing performance concerns.
* Provide team members recognition, gap assessment, and overall performance documentation to support and reinforce career and personal growth.
* Develop, maintain, and disseminate product and general company knowledge through appropriate communication channels.


Guest (i.e., Customer) Experience
  
  

* Provide salesfloor leadership to team members, including planning salesfloor coverage and making decisions to maintain efficiency and effectiveness of salesfloor operations.
* Support team members (e.g., leading by example or coaching) with ensuring a great guest experience that values guests' time, including assessing guest needs, providing technical product educations, and supporting in\-store transactions and omnichannel programs (e.g., buy online/pickup in store, phone sales, and ship from store options).
* Interact with and assess guests' unique needs to provide customized, effective purchase and return solutions and support.
* Provide technical product education by articulating the value and benefit of the product.
* Resolve guest feedback and address guest concerns or escalations to make it "right" for guests.
* Move dynamically on the floor to assess and fulfill the needs of the business, team, and guests.


Working with Others
  
  

* Contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and celebrating differences to ensure a supportive and engaging experience for all team members and guests.
* Establish supportive and productive relationships with all team members.
* Collaborate with team members to ensure optimal guest experience and support store operations.


Operations

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-258826 **Date posted** 08/26/2026
**About Evinova**


Evinova enables global life sciences to accelerate better health outcomes through innovative digital health solutions for clinical research.


**Role Overview**


Evinova is seeking an entrepreneurial, AI\-fluent Product Director to take ownership of a core product area, building it from the ground up with AI at its foundation. This is a founding product leadership role: you will define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI\-native product that fundamentally changes how clinical development and clinical operations teams work—designing for the end user first, enabling seamless, collaborative workflows, and driving connectivity across Evinova’s modules so that the platform works as one.


As Product Director, you will operate with significant autonomy and act as the general manager for your product area at Evinova. This is an individual contributor role: you will not have direct reports, but you will lead and inspire a matrixed, cross\-functional team—engineering, design, data science, and commercial—through vision, influence, and clarity. You will identify whitespace, validate opportunities directly with end users and customers, ship V1 products, and iterate relentlessly—embedding AI and machine learning into every layer of the product build, maintenance, and experience, and driving connectivity across Evinova’s modules so workflows flow seamlessly for clinical development and clinical operations teams. This role requires a builder who thrives in ambiguity and brings the conviction to create something new within a world\-class life sciences software organization.

**Build an AI\-Native Product from Zero to One**


* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and multi\-year roadmap for an AI\-native product, from first principles through scale.
* Develop a deep, first\-hand understanding of our users, their problem spaces, and their day\-to\-day workflows—pinpointing where the product can deliver step\-function impact rather than incremental gains.
* Drive rapid hypothesis validation through prototyping and experimentation.
* Own the full product lifecycle end\-to\-end: from concept and design through development, launch, go\-to\-market, and post\-launch iteration informed by usage data and customer feedback.

**Lead AI\-Native Product Development**


* Architect the product with AI and machine learning at its core—for example: intelligent automation, contextual recommendations, predictive insights, and generative AI–powered workflows that reduce effort for end users.
* Collaborate closely with data science and engineering teams to translate cutting\-edge AI capabilities into practical, regulation\-aware product features.
* Design for the end user first—building intuitive, collaborative workflows that reduce burden and enable clinical development and clinical operations teams to work seamlessly together, with connectivity across Evinova’s modules.
* Meet users where they are and guide them through their change management journey—earning adoption by easing the transition to new, AI\-enabled ways of working rather than forcing it.
* Maintain a sharp point of view on the evolving clinical trial and AI landscape—proactively identifying opportunities to apply emerging capabilities to the challenges faced by clinical development and clinical operations teams.

**Drive Strategic Leadership Across Evinova**


* Partner with a matrixed product organization to drive connectivity across Evinova’s modules and inform the product roadmap. Partner with commercial to ensure the product does not over\-fit to any one customer. Iterate relentlessly in pursuit of product\-market fit.
* Serve as the strategic product leader across the organization, aligning engineering, design, data science, and commercial around a unified product vision.
* Communicate product strategy, progress, and trade\-offs to Evinova’s executive leadership and key enterprise customers.
* Define and own success metrics—adoption, engagement, revenue contribution, clinical trial cycle\-time reduction—and drive data\-informed prioritization.

**Operate with Entrepreneurial Ownership**


* Treat your product area as your own business—own the P\&L mindset, make resource trade\-offs, and drive measurable commercial outcomes.
* Navigate the tension between speed\-to\-market and regulatory compliance (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, GDPR, HIPAA).
* Cultivate strategic partnerships with data providers and standards bodies (CDISC, HL7 FHIR) to accelerate Evinova’s product capabilities.
* Champion a culture of experimentation, intellectual honesty, and continuous learning within your product area and across the broader Evinova team.

**WHAT YOU BRING**


**Required Experience**


* 8\+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in a director\-level or senior product leadership capacity owning a product area end\-to\-end.
* Domain experience in clinical trials or life sciences. Customer Success Manager
description:
**About iSpeedToLead**
----------------------


iSpeedToLead is a two\-sided real estate lead marketplace operating across the United States. Sellers of motivated\-seller leads list on one side, and real estate investors buy on the other. We are a bootstrapped, profitable product company with an engineering and analytics team that ships fast and makes decisions from data rather than opinion.

**About the role**
------------------


This is the first dedicated Customer Success hire at iSpeedToLead. Today, buyers are supported reactively: tickets get answered, credits get issued, and nobody owns what happens to an account between its first purchase and its last one.


You will own the post\-purchase relationship with our buyers. That means onboarding them properly, keeping high\-value accounts healthy, and turning churn from something we observe into something we manage. You will build the function itself (playbooks, health scoring, reporting) rather than inherit it.


One thing worth stating openly before you apply: the workload is around 50 hours a week for the first 6 to 9 months while the function is being built. We would rather you decline now than discover it in month two.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Onboarding and activation**

* Own the onboarding of new buyers end to end, from first purchase to first repeat purchase.
* Run onboarding calls and follow\-ups, making sure every new buyer understands how to filter, buy, and work leads effectively.
* Design and maintain the onboarding sequence (content, timing, channel) and improve it based on what actually converts.

**Account health and retention**

* Manage a book of high\-value accounts with regular check\-ins, usage reviews, and proactive outreach.
* Build and maintain a health\-scoring model that flags at\-risk accounts before they churn, not after.
* Run save conversations on at\-risk accounts and document what worked, by reason code.

**Escalations and problem\-solving**

* Act as the escalation point for buyer complaints, including lead quality disputes, refund requests, and billing or balance issues.
* Coordinate with support, sales, and engineering to resolve issues, and follow through until the customer confirms resolution.
* Operate within agreed refund and credit authority limits, and defend those decisions with data.

**Voice of the customer**

* Collect, categorise, and quantify churn and refund reasons, turning anecdotes into a ranked list.
* Deliver a weekly written report to product and leadership on retention performance and the top issues driving cancellations.
* Advocate for the product changes that would remove recurring causes of churn.

**Process and reporting**

* Build the Customer Success playbooks from scratch: onboarding, save, win\-back, and escalation.
* Maintain accurate account records and interaction history in our systems.
* Report on retention metrics weekly, and own the definitions behind them.

**Collaboration**

* Work daily with sales on the handoff of new buyers, and with support on ticket patterns.
* Partner with product and analytics on lifecycle experiments and instrumentation.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 2\+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Retention in a high\-volume, low\-ACV environment such as a marketplace, self\-serve SaaS, or transactional product with hundreds of accounts. (Enterprise CSM experience with a handful of large logos is a different job and will not transfer well here.)
* Demonstrated ownership of a retention, churn, or repeat\-purchase metric. You can describe what it was, what you changed, and what it became.
* Comfortable working with data: SQL basics or strong BI fluency (Amplitude, Metabase, Looker, BigQuery, or similar). You pull your own numbers rather than requesting them.
* Experience building a process from zero, such as an onboarding flow, a save playbook, or a health\-score model. Executing someone else's process is not the same thing.
* Written and spoken English at C1 level, customer\-facing, at volume.
* Confident on the phone with US small\-business customers. Our buyers are real estate investors: direct, busy, and blunt.
* Practical use of AI tools in your daily workflow (call summarisation, drafting, triage) with examples you can show.
* A minimum of 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in real estate, proptech, lead generation, or a marketplace with wallet or prepaid\-balance mechanics.
* Familiarity with Intercom, HubSpot, or a comparable CRM and support stack.
* Experience designing lifecycle email or automation flows.
* Ukrainian or Russian in addition to English.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Full ownership of a metric that shows up directly in the P\&L, with no layer between you and leadership.
* A greenfield function. You design how Customer Success works here.
* Real data infrastructure and an AI\-native team, so arguments get settled with numbers and tooling is not a fight.
* A clear 12\-month growth path to Head of Retention or Head of Customer Success, including automation of the low\-touch tier and one to two direct reports.
* Remote work with flexible hours inside the required US overlap.
* Referral bonus of USD 3,000 after probation for anyone you bring in.

* 5 years of experience in facilities maintenance or equivalent related functions.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Analytical, problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to lead and manage teams and projects.
* Attention to detail but also to see the implications for the bigger picture
* Commercial and customer service awareness
* Organisation, time management, prioritising and the ability to handle various things at the same time.
* Good knowledge of IT packages.
* Fluent Spanish and English is a must.
### **Additional information**

**About us:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.  



If you think this role is made for you, please send us your CV!


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

* Design and run lightweight experimentation programmes including challenges, hackathons, discovery sprints that surface new AI applications and build confidence across teams.
* Act as the CF technology team’s primary AI thought leader and strategic advisor to leadership translating field\-level insight into strategic recommendations.
* Stay current with AI developments across the industry particularly in financial services and bring relevant intelligence into AI CoE leadership conversations and roadmap decisions.
* Advise CF business stakeholders on how AI can be applied to their specific domains, translating technical capability into business value language.
* Build, test, and iterate on AI\-powered tools, prototypes, and integrations demonstrating feasibility and sparking wider adoption through working examples.
* Design and implement end\-to\-end AI solutions including RAG pipelines, LLM\-powered applications, and agentic workflows that connect AI to real business processes.
* Evaluate internal and SaaS AI models, platforms, and tooling including LLMs, agentic frameworks, and productivity tools and make grounded recommendations based on practical, production\-aware experience.

We are looking for


* Demonstrable hands\-on experience building software, with confidence working in a modern development environment and credibility with engineering teams.
* Practical, working experience with AI models and tools including LLMs, prompt engineering, AI\-assisted coding tools such as GitHub CoPilot or equivalent. Demonstrable delivery of at least one RAG implementation, an agentic workflow, a fine\-tuned model, or a production LLM integration.

* Experience working in or closely with technology teams in complex organizations — ideally within financial services, professional services, or similarly regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple organizational layers from coaching junior developers to briefing senior leadership
* Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.
* Proficiency in Python (strongly preferred) and comfort working in a modern development environment
* Working knowledge of LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent and experience building applications on top of them beyond simple prompting.
* Hands\-on experience with AI development tooling: vector databases, embedding models, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation and observability approaches.
* Understanding of agentic AI patterns, including tool use, planning, multi\-agent coordination with experience designing or building systems that use them.
* Understanding of how regulated financial services organizations operate including data sensitivity, compliance constraints, and the specific risk appetite that shapes technology decisions.
* Awareness of how leading financial institutions are approaching AI adoption.
* Ability to translate AI capability into business value language relevant to financial services such as risk reduction, control improvement, cost efficiency, revenue enablement, client experience and making the case to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrably well\-read on AI developments. You follow research, read technical blogs, track model releases, and can hold a credible conversation about where the field is heading and what it means for the organisation.

title: Lifestyle Agent
description:
**THE RESIDENCES**


Mandarin Oriental has experienced exponential growth in the development of The Residences at Mandarin Oriental, in combination with hotels, to form complex mixed\-use and stand\-alone projects. Integral to the growth of the Mandarin Oriental footprint, Residences are a new paradigm, and as such require focused operational expertise. In addition to the goal of delivering superior experiences and services to Residences owners, Mandarin Oriental is focused not only on the management of the Residences common areas to the very high standards our guests have become accustomed, but to continually improving our relationship with Residence owners over the long term.

  

**STRATEGIC INTENT**


The mission of this position is for the incumbent to assume full responsibility for all aspects of residential services, concierge operations, and the lifestyle experience of our residents during both the pre\-opening and post\-opening phases.


The ideal candidate will be proactive, creative, and resident\-centric, with a strong focus on excellence and operational efficiency. They must consistently keep the residents’ perspective in mind when delivering services and products and always represent the brand with professionalism and integrity. This role also serves as a key development opportunity for operations\-focused professionals aspiring to advance into positions within Group Residences or Hotel operations across MOHG projects.


The incumbent is expected to demonstrate tenacity, creativity, flexibility, and unwavering commitment to ensure a successful residential launch, strategic positioning, and continued operation — all delivered on budget and on time.  



**SCOPE OF POSITION / SUMMARY**


The Lifestyle Attendant is responsible for the organisation, coordination, monitoring and maintaining of their shift to ensure a smooth and efficient operation of all the exclusive Amenities including the Fitness Center, Spa facilities, the indoor and outdoor pool, the meeting room, the lounge areas, the library, the Golf Simulator and wet\-areas of the residences and any other health / outdoor activities provided.  

  

  



Also, the Lifestyle Agent is responsible for assisting and supporting Residential Concierge and Residential Porter with their full scope of duties duties.

  



**ORGANIZATION STRUCTURE**

  



The Lifestyle Attendant reports to Lead Concierge and subsequently to the Director of Residences.

  



**DUTIES AND SUPPORTING RESPONSIBILITIES**

  



The Lifestyle Agent responsibilities:  

  

  



* Effectively coordinates the usage of the Lifestyle area and Community activities.
* Review the cleanliness of the exclusive Amenities during the shift and maintain it in accordance with MOHG Standards (i.e. set up of treatment room, maintain the stock of towels, water, etc… at the fitness centre and changing rooms, disinfection of fitness equipment, etc…)
* Proactively greet, interact, and assist residence owners in a professional manner.
* Identify and report defects throughout the residential area; notify the Residences Management team immediately of hazards, injuries, equipment or processes that negatively affect the operations.
* Report all requests and complaints to the Residences Management team to ensure issues are resolved immediately and followed up to ensure the resident’s satisfaction.
* To aid therapists and private practitioners in setting up for treatments as well as clearing away after.
* To ensure that lockers are stocked with clean linen at all times and removing soiled items.
* To ensure fitness center is always clean and with sufficient stock of towels, drinks, etc…
* Make sure all equipment at fitness center is disinfected after every use.
* To attend to residents in all areas, ensuring that they are comfortable as well as offering refreshments.
* Be knowledgeable with AV equipment and be able to set up equipment on demand.
* Maintain complete knowledge and comply with all residential and Management Company departmental policies and procedures.
* Maintain correct records for FLHSS audit.
* Maintain strict confidentiality relative to Residents and Residences business.
* Practice teamwork, create a positive work environment, greet fellow employees and thank them when they lend assistance.
* Proactively seek to provide refined luxury service ensuring resident satisfaction.
* Ability to focus attention on resident needs, remaining calm and courteous.
* Assist Residential Concierge in any duty deemed appropriate by the Concierge such as the delivery / pick up / purchase of desk services, for those services that need to be performed away from the desk such as deliveries of food, laundry, etc…
* Anticipate residents’ needs, respond promptly and acknowledge all residents, however busy and whatever time of day.
* Accommodate all Residents requests expediently and courteously. Follow up with designated Residential or Management Company personnel to ensure completion of request.
* Protect and utilise Management Company assets in a responsible and professional manner.
* Participate in the property’s sustainability initiative through energy conservation and the use of recycling programs and materials.
* Always show a professional attitude, particularly with regard to punctuality, appearance and general manner.
* Provide food and beverage service upon resident request, ensuring a seamless and personalized experience.
* To carry out any other reasonable requests as directed by your manager.

  



**REQUIREMENTS ON CORE COMPETENCIES**

  



The Lifestyle Agent requires the following personal attributes:


* Delighting our Customers


* Delighting our Colleagues


* Communicates a compelling vision
* Inspires co\-operation and commitment
* Adapts work style and ethics appropriately
* Actively listens and builds on other ideas
* Effectively understands and uses resources
* Is culturally sensitive
* Good written and verbal skills

  



* Becoming the Best


* Achievement orientated
* Makes things happen
* Has presence
* Has positive impact and influence
* Generates, innovative options
* Adapts plans to suit change
* Seeks continuous improvement opportunities

  



* Working together


* Has energy and drive
* A sense of urgency
* Motivating individual
* Communicates clearly
* Open to feedback and learning
* Operates ethically
* High level of personal integrity


* Acting with Responsibility


* Can identify core issues and problems
* Emotionally stable and mature
* Accepts feedback
* Coaches others
* Manages responsibilities

  



**Requirements – Experience, Skills, Education and Qualifications**
-------------------------------------------------------------------


* Have a minimum of one year’s experience in similar position, preferably in a luxury environment.
* Excellent communication skills in all aspects.
* To be passionate about delivering the very best recreation, fitness and leisure experience for your residents.
* Approachable, confident, composed, and is able to work well in a team environment.
* Flexible work hours to meet the demands of the operation.
* Good verbal skills in Spanish and English.

description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***

**Who We Are…**

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the *storytellers* bringing our characters to life, the *creators* bringing them to your living rooms and the *dreamers* creating what’s next…


From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

**Your New Role...**
Join Warner Bros. Pictures and play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering publicity campaigns for the theatrical slate in Spain. Working closely with the Senior Director of Publicity, Italy and Spain, you will ensure campaigns are culturally relevant, aligned with international objectives, and generate meaningful audience engagement and earned media impact.
If you are passionate about entertainment publicity, thrive in a fast\-paced environment and enjoy working across high\-profile film releases, we would love to hear from you.**Your Role Accountabilities*** Oversee Spanish publicity campaigns from strategy through execution, localising global plans to maximise relevance and impact within the Spanish market while identifying creative opportunities that drive earned media coverage and audience engagement.
* Act as the primary publicity contact for Spain, partnering with cross\-functional teams across Marketing, Distribution, Creative, Social, Media and Promotions, while coordinating relationships with filmmakers, talent teams and external PR agencies.
* Lead the planning and delivery of publicity activity in Spain, including talent tours, premieres, special screenings, awards campaigns, film festival participation and other cultural moments that enhance campaign visibility.
* Coordinate talent schedules, oversee tour and junket logistics, and manage supplier negotiations and onboarding processes, including purchase orders, vendor creation and contracts.
* Coordinate the Spanish publicity budget, monitor campaign performance against agreed objectives and KPIs, and provide clear status updates to senior stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across print, broadcast, online and influencer media, securing high\-quality editorial coverage and coordinating participation in local and international media opportunities.
* Support publicity strategies for local productions, oversee publicity materials and media monitoring activities, and coordinate the publicity team while supporting their development and ensuring delivery across multiple film titles.

**Qualifications \& Experience*** Extensive experience in publicity, communications or PR within an entertainment company, film studio, media organisation or specialised agency in a management level position.
* Excellent written and spoken English skills with the ability to draft, adapt and present clear communications for local and international stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of the Spanish media landscape, including entertainment, film, lifestyle, online and influencer media.
* Proven ability to coordinate multiple projects and priorities simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
* Collaborative approach with experience working effectively with internal teams, external agencies, media partners and international offices.

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. title: Nômade Temple Madrid - F&B Director
description:
**About Nômade Temple Madrid**


Nômade Temple Madrid is more than a space, it is a vibrant hub where community, creativity, and conscious living meet in the heart of the city. Inspired by the bohemian and soulful essence of the Nômade universe, we bring together gastronomy, culture, wellness, and lifestyle to create meaningful and elevated experiences.

**Your role**


As **F\&B Director**, you will be responsible for leading the overall Food \& Beverage strategy and operation at Nômade Temple Madrid, overseeing our restaurants, bars, events, and F\&B experiences while ensuring that each outlet reflects the Nômade philosophy and achieves the highest standards of guest experience, operational excellence, team engagement, and financial performance. Working closely with the General Manager and the leadership team, you will drive the commercial and operational performance of the department, identify new opportunities, develop innovative concepts, optimize revenue and profitability, and lead a high\-performing team that delivers authentic, memorable, and distinctive hospitality experiences.

**What you will do**

* Define and lead the overall Food \& Beverage strategy for Nômade Temple Madrid, aligned with the brand vision and business objectives.
* Oversee the daily operation and performance of all F\&B outlets, ensuring consistency in service, quality, presentation, and guest experience.
* Develop and implement annual F\&B budgets, business plans, revenue strategies, and operational objectives.
* Drive profitability through effective management of revenue, food cost, beverage cost, labor cost, productivity, and operational expenses.
* Monitor key F\&B performance indicators and develop action plans to maximize revenue and profitability.
* Lead the development and continuous evolution of our restaurant, bar, rooftop, event, and other F\&B concepts.
* Ensure that each outlet has a clear identity while maintaining a consistent Nômade approach to hospitality.
* Collaborate closely with the Executive Chef and culinary leadership to develop menus, concepts, pricing strategies, and gastronomic experiences.
* Work together with Marketing, Events, Wellness, Sales, and Operations teams to create innovative experiences and activations that connect with our guests and community.
* Build strong relationships with suppliers, partners, producers, and external collaborators.
* Lead recruitment, onboarding, training, development, and succession planning across the F\&B department.
* Inspire and develop F\&B leaders, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, creativity, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and maintain service standards, operational procedures, and quality benchmarks across all F\&B areas.
* Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, health \& safety, licensing, and company standards.
* Analyze guest feedback, market trends, and industry developments to continuously improve the F\&B offering.
* Identify new commercial opportunities and partnerships that can increase revenue and strengthen the positioning of Nômade Temple Madrid.
* Represent the F\&B department within the hotel's leadership team and act as an ambassador of the Nômade brand.
* Contribute to the long\-term positioning and growth of Nômade Temple Madrid as a distinctive hospitality and lifestyle destination in Madrid.

**Who we’re looking for**

* An inspiring and commercially minded F\&B leader with a genuine passion for hospitality, gastronomy, and guest experience.
* A strategic thinker who can translate a brand vision into successful and profitable F\&B operations.
* A natural leader capable of inspiring, developing, and empowering diverse teams.
* Strong business acumen and a clear understanding of F\&B financial performance.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* A creative and entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and turn ideas into experiences.
* Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to maintain a clear strategic perspective.
* A hands\-on leader who understands that exceptional hospitality is created through both people and operational excellence.
* Adaptable, resilient, and comfortable working in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment.

**Requirements**

* Extensive experience in a senior Food \& Beverage leadership position, preferably as F\&B Director, F\&B Manager, or equivalent within luxury hotels, lifestyle hospitality, high\-end restaurants, or multi\-outlet operations.
* Proven experience managing multiple F\&B outlets and complex hospitality operations.
* Strong knowledge of F\&B financial management, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and revenue optimization.
* Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing F\&B concepts and commercial strategies.
* Proven track record of leading, developing, and retaining high\-performing teams.
* Strong understanding of luxury hospitality service standards and guest experience.
* Knowledge of food safety, hygiene, health \& safety, and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Excellent organizational and problem\-solving skills.
* Fluency in Spanish and English.
* Additional languages are a plus.
* Valid EU / Spain work permit.

**Why join us?**


Because at Nômade, hospitality is not just operations, it is emotion, precision, and experience. You will be part of a vibrant environment where people, culture, and creativity come together to create unforgettable moments.

***Equal Opportunity Commitment***

*At Nômade Temple, we are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and respectful environment for all. We ensure equal opportunities in our recruitment process and guarantee fair treatment regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. All hiring decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and alignment with our values.*

description:
Job Description:
**Global Marketing Associate**


 AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  

Warsaw, Poland or Madrid, Spain.


At AXA XL, we build and protect our market profile and brand by proactively shaping and executing an integrated global marketing programme, in close alignment with our Chief Client Office and regional business unit strategies. The Global Marketing Associate will help to achieve AXA XL’s global marketing goals by contributing to increased market visibility for our products and services, including thought leadership, amongst clients, brokers and the industries we serve.


As a Global Marketing Associate, you will support the Global Marketing Director and wider team in developing, coordinating and delivering marketing activity for AXA XL’s key growth areas: Future of Energy, Data Centers and Multinational Solutions. The role will also support wider Chief Client Office marketing programmes, including global events, sponsorships, client engagement campaigns and digital marketing activation across account\-based marketing, email, webinar and website channels. You will also work closely with regional marketing teams to help provide consistent and up\-to\-date global marketing resources that enhance our market presence.


In this role, you will provide hands\-on marketing support across planning, campaign delivery, content development, stakeholder coordination and performance reporting. You will work closely with members of the global marketing team and with internal and outsourced resources, while contributing to global internal and external Communications, Brand and Marketing projects and Chief Client Office initiatives.


**What****you’ll be doing**
---------------------------


What will your essential responsibilities include?


* Supporting the Global Marketing Director and business stakeholders in developing global marketing resources that support retention, new business and brand positioning across strategic growth areas including Future of Energy, Data Centers and Multinational Solutions.
* Assisting with the delivery of integrated marketing campaigns using the full suite of marketing tools and channels, such as digital advertising, account\-based marketing, email campaigns, webinar programmes, collateral material, web content, events and sponsorships.
* Supporting marketing plans for key growth initiatives, including Future of Energy, Data Centers and Multinational Solutions.
* Providing coordination and execution support for global events, sponsorships and client engagement programmes, including planning, stakeholder management, content development, logistics support and post\-event reporting.
* Contributing to marketing activity that supports Chief Client Office priorities, including client growth, broker engagement, strategic account development and global campaign activation.
* Supporting regional Distribution and marketing teams with up\-to\-date global marketing resources, campaign materials and messaging guidance.
* Collaborating with regional marketing teams and the Global Brand team to help ensure consistent marketing materials are used and best practices are shared.
* Working with the Digital Marketing team to maintain and update website content for priority growth areas and support the execution of global digital marketing campaigns, including account\-based marketing, email marketing, webinar programmes, paid digital activity and website updates.
* Supporting performance reporting across campaigns, events, sponsorships and digital channels, including engagement metrics, lead generation, pipeline influence and return on investment where available.
* Supporting CRM discipline and campaign tracking by helping ensure relevant marketing activity, client engagement and follow\-up actions are captured accurately in CRM systems.
* Drafting, editing and coordinating copy for collateral material, web content, presentations and campaign assets, working with internal teams and outsourced agencies as needed.
* Using data\-driven insights and analytical tools to monitor campaign performance, compile reports and support recommendations for optimization.
* Helping ensure timely execution of projects by coordinating with internal Brand \& Design, Media/PR, Digital and other relevant teams.
* Representing the Global Marketing function in selected internal business meetings and supporting preparation for external industry events.
* Supporting relationships with external marketing agencies and helping manage project timelines, deliverables and budgets.
* Building effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, including Sales, Product, Distribution and Executive teams.


You will report to the Global Marketing Director.**What****you’ll bring**
------------------------

We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:


* Experience in commercial and/or B2B marketing, with the ability to support planning, coordination and delivery across multiple projects simultaneously.
* A collaborative, proactive approach and a passion for helping deliver intelligent, creative work as part of a team, for measurable success.
* Excellent written and oral communication abilities alongside an outstanding attention to detail.
* Proven ability to work independently and in a collaborative, hybrid team\-oriented environment
* Robust organizational skills and the ability to support time\-critical projects through planning, scheduling, monitoring and budget tracking.
* Experience supporting digital marketing activation, including account\-based marketing, email campaigns, webinars, CRM\-supported campaign tracking and website content management.
* A keen ability to execute, deliver results, approach tasks proactively and anticipate needs.
* Eager to learn and focused on continuously improving technical skills.
* Experience in Insurance or Financial Services industry is preferred.
* BA in Marketing or Communications or equivalent.

-----------------------

At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential. *It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*

Social Media Manager
description:
Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra, Mallorca is looking for a **Social Media Manager** to join our **Sales \& Marketing Team.**


Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.


Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group is the award\-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought\-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting\-edge of luxury experiences.


Set against the stunning backdrop of Puerto Portals, Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra pulses with the vibrant spirit of Mallorca. Here, subtle and emotional luxury seamlessly blend with the island’s natural beauty and energy, offering a place where inspiration flows effortlessly. Celebrate the essence of Mallorca through bespoke experiences, dynamic culinary journeys, and rejuvenating wellness \- each designed to immerse you in the island’s vibrant atmosphere and extraordinary offerings.


**About the job**


Based at Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra, Mallorca, as the Social Media Manager, you will be responsible for developing and implementing social media strategies in order to increase online presence and improve marketing and sales efforts of the resort and its outlets. This position works closely with different departments to develop and execute the story telling at the resort.


**As Social Media Manager, you will be responsible for the following duties:**


* With the guidance of the Director of Marketing Communications, design and implement the hotel’s social media and e\-commerce strategy with KPIs.
* Proactively plan creative, compelling, and targeted social media activity and campaigns.
* Stay informed of upcoming trends and developments within the field of social media.
* Research and develop new ways to leverage social content to improve performance.
* Setting KPIs for social media agencies and using relevant social media monitoring tools to manage all the resort’s social channels.
* Conduct competitive analysis of studies on competition and provide recommendations on content changes for the resort’s social channels.
* Oversee and manage all social media accounts for the resort, including each F\&B outlet, while leading community management strategies and daily engagement for every account.
* Prepare and implement the annual social media content strategy in accordance to brand.
* Plan and execute social media influencer campaigns, working closely with local and/or international influencers / KOLs and with the Public Relations agency.
* Collaborate create and execute social media campaigns that will generate leads, drive quality traffic and fans/follower’s engagement.
* Prepare monthly reports on social media for distribution to department heads and executive committee.
* Work closely with various departments to produce quality content for social media.
* Writing, commissioning, and editing materials for a range of key hotel audiences for use across all social media platforms.
* Plan, organize and oversee all social media photography / videography sessions.
**As Social Media Manager, we expect from you:**


Experience and education


* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, eCommerce Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 2 years of solid experience in a similar role, preferably within the luxury hospitality sector (resort experience is considered a plus).
Technical Skills


* Excellent communication skills with an articulate and compelling communication style.
* Strong writing ability, capable of adapting tone and style to different audiences and communication platforms.
* Proven project management skills with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
* Creative mindset with the ability to think innovatively and work with flair and imagination.
* Strong communication skills in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.
**Our commitment to you**


* Learning \& Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.
* MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the \#MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones.
* Health \& Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work\-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.
**We’re Fans. Are you?**
