title: Director of Design Quality Assurance
description:
At the MBTA, we envision a thriving region enabled by a best\-in\-class transit system. Our mission is to serve the public by providing safe, reliable, and accessible transportation. MBTA’s core values are built around safety, service, equity, sustainability, culture, and accessibility, and each employee that works for the MBTA performs their roles based on our vision, mission, and values. This includes attendance, participation, and contribution in local safety committee meetings as needed.



**Job Summary**
---------------

The Director of Design Quality Assurance (QA) serves as the MBTA's senior authority for design quality management across the Capital Investment Program and is responsible for establishing, implementing, and continuously improving design quality assurance policies, standards, procedures, and governance practices for planning, design, and construction phase service activities.  

  

The Director provides strategic leadership for design quality management initiatives supporting the Authority's multi\-billion\-dollar capital program and ensures compliance with Federal Transit Administration (FTA) requirements, MBTA standards, industry best practices, and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.  

The Director partners with executive leadership, engineering disciplines, project delivery teams, operations, maintenance, safety, consultants, contractors, and external regulatory agencies to promote a culture of quality, reduce project risk, improve project delivery performance, and ensure the successful delivery of safe, reliable, and sustainable transit infrastructure.  

  

The position is accountable for quality governance, design quality performance, organizational development, consultant quality oversight, lessons learned programs, quality audits, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the project lifecycle.


**Duties \& Responsibilities**
------------------------------

* Provide strategic leadership, oversight, and continuous improvement of the MBTA's Design Quality Assurance Program in support of the Authority's Capital Investment Program.
* Establish, implement, and maintain quality assurance policies, procedures, standards, and governance frameworks for planning, design, and construction phase service activities.
* Direct the execution and ongoing enhancement of the MBTA Quality Management Plan (QMP) and related quality management systems.
* Develop and implement quality objectives, performance measures, key performance indicators (KPIs), and reporting tools to monitor design quality performance across the Capital Program.
* Lead quality assurance audits, surveillances, assessments, and compliance reviews to ensure adherence to MBTA standards, Federal Transit Administration (FTA) requirements, applicable codes, and industry best practices.
* Oversee the review and approval of consultant project specific Project Quality Plans and ensure consistent implementation across all capital projects.
* Serve as the executive lead for the identification, evaluation, mitigation, and reporting of design quality risks affecting project cost, schedule, safety, operability, and maintainability.
* Direct the development, implementation, and monitoring of corrective and preventive action programs to address design quality deficiencies and improve project delivery outcomes.
* Lead the MBTA Designer Errors and Omissions (E\&O) Program, including participation in the E\&O Committee, trend analysis, cost recovery efforts, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Serve as a standing and voting member of Designer Selection Committees and provide quality\-related recommendations regarding consultant procurement and selection.
* Establish and maintain consultant performance management programs, including oversight of Consultant Performance Evaluation Reports (CPERs) and quality\-related performance metrics.
* Develop and maintain standard design and construction scope templates, technical requirements, and quality provisions for consultant contracts and procurements.
* Oversee the Capital Program Project Development Group (PDG) process and monitor compliance with project governance, quality standards, and stage\-gate requirements.
* Analyze quality data, audit findings, lessons learned, and performance trends to identify systemic issues and implement process improvements.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Capital Delivery, Operations, Maintenance, Safety, Environmental, and other Authority departments to ensure quality requirements are integrated throughout the project lifecycle.
* Represent the MBTA in design quality\-related matters involving regulatory agencies, external auditors, consultants, contractors, industry organizations, and other stakeholders.
* Provide executive\-level guidance and recommendations to senior leadership regarding design quality performance, project risks, policy development, and organizational improvement opportunities.
* Direct, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team of quality managers, auditors, engineers, and technical professionals while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Manage departmental staffing, resource planning, succession planning, and workforce development initiatives to ensure organizational effectiveness.
* Develop, administer, and monitor departmental budgets, consultant resources, and operational expenditures to ensure efficient utilization of Authority resources.
* Support procurement activities, contract negotiations, and consultant selection processes to ensure quality requirements are appropriately incorporated into contracts and scopes of work.
* Drive a company or personal vehicle to attend job meetings as required and visit job sites and field offices to obtain first\-hand knowledge of projects.
* Respond to each inquiry, whether from a customer, vendor or coworker in a courteous and professional manner which is consistent with the MBTA’s customer service quality standard.
* Respond to emergencies, either directly or through subordinates, on a twenty\-four (24\) hour, seven (7\) day per week basis.
* Work in the office at least three days per week, and up to five days per week as directed.
* Uphold the rights and interests of the MBTA while building and maintaining an effective relationship with employees.
* Perform all other duties and projects that may be assigned.

***Additional responsibilities may include a focus on one or more departments or locations. See applicable addendum for department or location\-specific functions.***  

  

**Supervision**  

* Supervise, directly and / or indirectly through managers, a technical and administrative staff comprised of QA Managers and QA auditors.
  


**Minimum Requirements \& Qualifications**
------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.
* Seven (7\) years of progressive experience in the design of major projects.
* Five (5\) years of supervisory, manager or leader experience managing professional, technical staff.
* Strong oral, written and interpersonal skills; effective organizational, analytical, and multitasking abilities.
* Strong people\-management and leadership skills, with the ability to foster collaboration and drive employee engagement.
* The ability to use the MSOffice suite of applications as well as database applications.
* The ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.
* Effectively communicate with customers, employees, contractors, and vendors.
* Possess excellent customer service, conflict resolution, time management, communication, presentation, and speaking skills.
* Must possess a valid driver’s license.
* The ability to work any shifts and/or locations as assigned or directed and be available to work twenty\-four (24\) hours per day, seven (7\) days per week.
* Ability to supervise and work effectively with a diverse workforce.

  

**Substitutions**  

* A master’s degree in a related subject substitutes for two (2\) years of general experience.
* A nationally recognized certification, or statewide/professional certification in a related field substitutes for one year of experience.
  


**Preferred Experience \& Skills**
----------------------------------


* A Master’s degree from an accredited institution in Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.
* Twelve (12\) years of related experience.
* Three (3\) years of experience as a QA/QC Engineer, QA/QC specialist, or similar role.
* Experience within a public transit or transportation agency or large public/private\-sector infrastructure organization.
* Experience with alternative project delivery methods including Design\-Build and or CMAR.
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or Six Sigma Black Belt certification.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or Registered Architect (RA) designation in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts.

**Job Conditions:**


* Ability to effectively read, comprehend, communicate, and respond to instructions, orders, signs, notices, inquiries, etc. in English.
* Be at least eighteen (18\) years of age, except if participating in an approved high school internship / co\-op program.
* Ability to commute to assigned work locations in the Boston, MA metro area, as required by the role.
* Ability to provide internal and external customers with courteous and professional experiences.

Additionally, interns / co\-ops must have valid work authorization and U.S. Social Security Number prior to starting pre\-employment screenings / pre\-boarding, working in their positions, and throughout the duration of their program.

**About the Role**

Genesys is looking for a Director of Customer Success Content to bring greater visibility to the innovation, expertise and value delivered through Customer Success, Professional Services and Orchestrators and to build the content and marketing engine that supports those teams.


This is a senior individual\-contributor role for an exceptional content creator, someone who can move fluidly across blogs, web copy, executive and analyst presentations, and branded slides, and who is equally comfortable writing CS/PS web copy as building the deck that pitches CS value to Sales or feeds the Gartner Magic Quadrant submission. This is a highly collaborative, hands\-on role for a strong content producer who can turn complex, technical or fragmented input into compelling content across formats and audiences, creating content that is meaningfully better than anything the services marketing function has produced before.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

### **Bring Customer Success and Professional Services to life**

title: Director, Solutions Strategy
description:
**ABOUT APPLY**

APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI\-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com.

**LOCATION:** *APPLY is hybrid/remote\-friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in* ***Latin America****, preferably working in hours that align to* ***PT (Pacific Timezone) or*** ***ET (Eastern Timezone)****. Candidates located in Santiago, Chile are able to work out of our Santiago office as remote/hybrid employees. Candidates located outside of Santiago, Chile will be fully remote employees.*

**THE ROLE:**  

As Director, Solutions Strategy, you are the person who turns a client's business problem into a credible, buildable solution — and then makes sure that solution holds up through delivery.



You operate in two directions at once. Facing outward, you shape technology solutions for new opportunities: leading discovery, supporting the definition of scope and shape, assessing vendors and partners, and presenting recommendations and trade\-offs to client stakeholders. Facing inward, you raise the quality of how Apply solutions as a whole: the approaches we reuse, the estimating models we trust, and the strategists and technologists who learn the craft from you.



You are a senior practitioner and a mentor. Your influence comes from the quality of your thinking, the trust you build with client technology leadership, and the strategists, architects, and Technology Directors who are better because they worked alongside you.



The role at a glance: provide technology recommendations that balance client expectations, strategic vision, customer experience, and engineering excellence.



### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**


### **Solution Strategy \& Pre\-Sales**


* Design enterprise\-grade technology solutions for new initiatives and business opportunities.
* Define solution scope, capacity, and high\-level estimates in collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, Data, and other relevant disciplines and teams.
* Present and articulate technology solutions, trade\-offs, and recommendations to client stakeholders — including where we recommend *against* something.
* Lead technology and vendor assessments, and act as a key voice in buy\-vs.\-build decisions.
* Engage the technology partner ecosystem when defining solutions, bringing partner capability to bear on the client's actual problem rather than the reverse.
* Ensure proposed solutions balance business objectives, technical feasibility, scalability, delivery realities, and long\-term client strategy.
* Contribute materially to pipeline quality and win rate on the opportunities you shape.
  


### **Client \& Technology Leadership**


* Own and develop relationships with the client's technology leadership and management teams as a trusted advisor.
* Understand the client's business and technology landscape well enough to identify credible opportunities for growth and expansion within existing accounts.
* Be accountable for the overall direction and coherence of the Technology and Strategy work within your engagements.
* Provide strategic direction to project delivery teams, and collaborate with other Senior Leaders across engagements.
* Act as a key member of the account team alongside leaders from other disciplines.
* Connect technology strategy, delivery execution, and account growth into long\-term client partnerships.
  


### **Craft \& Capability**


* Own and evolve how Apply approaches solutioning: reusable solution patterns, estimating and scoping models, assessment frameworks, and the standard of quality we hold proposals to.
* Raise the floor on solution quality across engagements you are not personally staffed on, through review, guidance, and shared standards.
### **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**


**Experience**


* At least 10 years working in and around enterprise IT environments.
* A blend of consulting and enterprise\-side experience.
* Substantial client\-facing experience, including gaining the confidence of senior stakeholders.
* A track record on complex solutions involving multiple systems, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Experience mentoring senior technologists and strategists, and influencing teams you do not manage.
  


  

**Technical breadth**


* A genuine technologist — strong understanding of web, mobile, and cloud technologies. A jack of all trades.


	+ Cloud and DevOps (AWS, Azure, GCP) — you have architected cloud solutions, or worked closely on projects deployed to the cloud.
	+ Data storage and transformation (RDBMS, NoSQL, big data / warehousing).
	+ API standards and integration patterns (REST, GraphQL).
	+ Familiarity with UX and single\-page application frameworks.
* Familiarity with MACH architecture and the broader evolution of enterprise systems — including 'monolith to composable' thinking and the realities of getting there.
* Strong understanding of headless and service\-oriented platforms.
* Wide exposure across the digital ecosystem: CMS, commerce and loyalty, CRM, marketing automation, personalization and testing, search and SEO, content marketing, social, mobile.
* Understanding of the regulatory and compliance requirements of enterprise solutions.
* Exposure to service design and business design practices.
* An appreciation of how upstream strategy and downstream enablement depend on each other.
  


  

**How you work**


* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills — you can distill messy information into a thoughtful, defensible recommendation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to make complex technical concepts legible to a non\-technical audience.
* Strong presentation and public speaking skills.
* The ability to align and influence critical stakeholders without positional authority.
* Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to know when to resolve it and when to name it.
* Ability to travel as needed for client meetings and business development.
**LIFE AT APPLY**

People are at the core of everything we do at APPLY. We provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow. Here are a few benefits we offer to support you:

**Agentic Delivery:** Our people work in a modern way to deliver client outcomes. Broaden your skills on a range of engagements with international brands that have a global impact.
**An inclusive and safe environment:** We’re truly committed to building a culture where you are celebrated and everyone feels welcome and safe.
**AI \& Strategic Upskilling:** Accelerate your professional growth with generous training budgets and mentorship, with a specific focus on Agentic AI expertise and the critical human skills required for the future of work.
**Generous vacation policy:** Work\-life balance is key to our team’s success, so we offer ample time away from work to promote overall well\-being.
**Flexible work arrangements:** We work in a variety of ways, from remote, to in\-office, to a blend of both.

APPLY is a safe, respectful, and inclusive community where differences are celebrated. We are committed to equal opportunity and fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. Learn more in our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) section. For recruitment accommodations, please email careers@applydigital.com.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
**WHO WE ARE**
Lindblad Expeditions is a true pioneer in Expedition Travel. From taking the first citizen explorers to Antarctica in 1966, opening the Galapagos and Easter Island to tourism in 1967, leading the first tourist expedition through the Northwest Passage in 1984, and launching our innovative partnership with National Geographic in 2004, we're now taking almost 30,000 guests a year to some of the world’s most remote and pristine locations on our fleet of 20 ships, and are committed to ensuring our guests experience the “Exhilaration of Discovery”. **POSITION SUMMARY**  



Lindblad Expeditions is seeking an exceptional leader to serve as Chief of Staff. This is a highly visible enterprise leadership role partnering directly with the CEO and Executive Leadership Team (ELT) to translate strategy into execution, lead complex cross\-functional initiatives, and improve organizational effectiveness.

Acting as an extension of the CEO, the Chief of Staff will help set and advance strategic priorities, strengthen the company's executive operating cadence, lead Board preparation, and take ownership of CEO\-sponsored initiatives that span functions or do not have a natural organizational owner.  



Success requires a distinctive combination of strategic thinking, business judgment, operational rigor, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable analyzing an ambiguous business problem, developing a recommendation, facilitating senior\-level discussions, and rolling up their sleeves to drive execution.

### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

**Strategic Partnership \& Enterprise Execution**
-------------------------------------------------


* Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the CEO, bringing perspective, analysis, and sound judgment to key business opportunities, organizational questions, and complex decisions.
* Partner with the CEO and ELT to define annual strategic priorities and translate them into clear enterprise objectives, ownership, milestones, and measures of progress.
* Build and run the enterprise operating cadence that converts strategic priorities and leadership decisions into consistent execution and follow\-through.
* Maintain a holistic view across the enterprise, identifying cross\-functional dependencies, emerging risks, execution gaps, and opportunities requiring CEO or ELT attention.
* Help focus the organization on its highest priorities and bring structure and momentum to issues that cut across functions or risk falling between organizational lines.

**CEO\-Sponsored Strategic Initiatives**
----------------------------------------


* Take ownership of high\-priority initiatives and complex problems on behalf of the CEO, particularly those that are ambiguous, cross\-functional, time\-sensitive, or lack a natural functional owner.
* Frame complex business questions, conduct or coordinate the necessary analysis, develop recommendations, and mobilize the right stakeholders to move from question to action.
* Drive initiatives end\-to\-end, from defining the problem and determining the path forward through stakeholder alignment, execution, and delivery of measurable outcomes.
* Serve as a flexible enterprise resource who can be deployed against emerging opportunities, organizational questions, and other priorities requiring focused leadership and ownership.

**CEO Communications \& Company Voice**
---------------------------------------


* Partner with the CEO to shape internal and external communications, ensuring clear and consistent messaging aligned with company strategy, priorities, and culture.
* Understand and authentically represent the CEO's voice and perspective across communications with employees, investors, media, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Draft CEO communications, including company\-wide messages, presentations, talking points, speeches, and stakeholder correspondence.
* Partner with Communications/PR, Investor Relations, People, and other teams to prepare the CEO for significant internal and external engagements.

**Board Materials \& Meeting Preparation**
------------------------------------------


* Partner with the CEO to shape Board meeting agendas, narratives, key topics, and decisions, ensuring the Board has the context and information needed for productive discussion.
* Lead the end\-to\-end development of Board materials, working with the CEO and ELT to synthesize company performance, strategic priorities, key opportunities, and areas requiring Board input.
* Coordinate inputs across the organization and drive preparation from initial planning through finalization, ensuring materials are clear, cohesive, high quality, and delivered on schedule.
* Bring an enterprise\-wide perspective to Board materials, connecting functional updates into a coherent story about the business.

**Executive Leadership Team, Culture \& Organizational Effectiveness**
----------------------------------------------------------------------


* Partner with the CEO to shape and facilitate ELT meetings and offsites, focusing leadership time on the company's most important priorities and decisions.
* Translate leadership decisions into clear ownership and action through the broader enterprise operating cadence.
* Serve as a trusted thought partner to the CEO and ELT on organizational culture and leadership effectiveness, providing candid, constructive feedback and identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain a strong pulse on the organization and help the CEO and ELT reinforce desired culture and behaviors through leadership actions, communications, and company\-wide initiatives.

**Executive \& External Stakeholder Engagement**
------------------------------------------------


* Build trusted relationships across the organization and serve as a highly credible extension of the CEO.
* Interface effectively with senior internal and external stakeholders, adapting communication and approach to the audience and situation.
* Represent the Office of the CEO with professionalism, sound judgment, discretion, and integrity.
* Handle highly confidential and sensitive matters with exceptional trustworthiness.
### **QUALIFICATIONS**


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Bachelor's degree required.
* 8–12\+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, general management, or another role requiring significant strategic and cross\-functional leadership.
* Demonstrated experience partnering directly with C\-suite executives on enterprise\-level strategy, operations, transformation, or other high\-priority business initiatives.
* Proven ability to take ownership of complex, ambiguous problems and drive them from initial question through analysis, decision, and execution.
* Experience leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives and influencing senior leaders without relying on formal authority.
* Strong analytical and business judgment, including experience using financial, operational, and business data to evaluate problems, develop recommendations, and support executive decision\-making.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information into clear executive\-level narratives, presentations, and recommendations.
* Experience establishing or managing strategic planning processes, executive operating cadences, KPIs/OKRs, or similar mechanisms for tracking enterprise priorities and execution.
* Strong executive presence and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and credibility quickly across all levels of an organization.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple high\-priority workstreams while maintaining focus on broader strategic objectives.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel and comfort working with collaboration, project management, and business reporting tools.
* High degree of integrity, professionalism, discretion, and trustworthiness.


 **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
============================


* MBA or other relevant advanced degree.
* Prior Chief of Staff experience or experience in a comparable enterprise strategy, transformation, or executive\-office role.
* Experience supporting Board of Directors or executive leadership communications, presentations, meeting preparation, or strategic decision\-making.
* Experience in experiential travel, hospitality, consumer brands, or another customer\-focused industry.
* Experience working within a public company or other complex, multi\-stakeholder operating environment.
Target Bonus 15%
Equity 5%

title: Director of Product - Network
description:
We were tired of hearing that healthcare is broken, so we decided to do something about it. At Nomi Health, we believe the care itself isn’t broken — it’s the business of healthcare that gets in the way. Every year, more than $1 trillion is wasted on paperwork, delays, and middle layers that drive up costs and keep people from the care they need.

We’re rebuilding the system so it works the way it should: clear prices you can trust, faster payments that keep providers focused on patients, and data that helps employers make better decisions. Our work has already touched more than 30 million lives — from local communities in Michigan to some of the largest companies in the country.
### **What You'll Do:**


* **Market solution design.** Partner with network, go\-to\-market, and sales teams to define and scope what Nomi can realistically deliver in each new market before it's sold, including provider coverage, TPA capability, and integration sequencing.
* **Partner and TPA data exchange.** Write the integration requirements between Nomi and every partner in the claim lifecycle — inbound claims, priced output, remittance, eligibility, file cadence, SLAs, and reconciliation — specific enough that an engineer on either side can build to it.
* **Network configuration and pricing.** Own the path from a signed rate sheet to a correctly priced claim: ingestion, normalization, versioning, effective dating, validation, and audit. Set the testing and release bar for anything that touches pricing.
* **Provider data, adequacy, and directory.** Own the provider data model and hierarchy — sponsor, tax ID, billing NPI, service location — and make network adequacy and directory accuracy measurable rather than asserted.
* **New segments and group types.** Evaluate new group types and segments as they come up, be willing to recommend against ones that don't fit, and defend that recommendation to sales.
* **The payments interface.** Recognize when a network change has payment\-side consequences and get ahead of it with the financial services and payments teams before it ships.
### **What We're Looking For:**


* **Reimbursement fluency.** You understand the difference between billed, allowed, and paid, and you've worked hands\-on with real fee schedules and rate methodologies, percent\-of\-Medicare, per diem, case rate, DRG, percent\-of\-charge.
* **Domain background.** You've built this expertise at a health plan, a TPA, a repricing or payment\-integrity vendor, a reference\-based\-pricing administrator, a provider revenue\-cycle organization, or a network contracting organization.
* **Data exchange experience.** You're comfortable with 837, 835, and eligibility file exchange, and you've written integration requirements that another team was able to build from successfully.
* **Commercial confidence.** You're comfortable representing Nomi directly in front of a broker, a TPA executive, or a health system, and making commitments you can stand behind.
* **A self\-directed approach.** You're comfortable defining your own priorities and figuring out what matters most, rather than working off a pre\-built roadmap.
* **Enough technical fluency to be credible.** You can read a data model, write SQL against it, and give an engineer clear enough direction that they're not left guessing. You won't be writing production code yourself.
* **Strong written communication.** Requirements documents are a core part of this role, so your writing should be clear, specific, and easy for others to build from.
### **Preferred Experiences:**

* Experience in self\-funded employer health: TPA administration, direct contracting, reference\-based pricing, or captives.
* You've run a platform migration or a vendor claims\-system implementation and lived through the reporting gap that follows.
* Founder or early\-operator background, or a track record of using automation and AI to replace manual operational work.

Nomi Health delivers disruptive healthcare solutions, in partnership with like\-minded employers, public sector organizations, advisors (brokers/consultants), and payers/TPAs. We’re a team of 300\+ people who show up every day with the same mindset: don’t settle for “that’s just how it is.” Real change happens when you challenge the system, cut through the excuses, and build something better together.

title: Director Product Design
description:
**About The Team**
 Design at Miro sits at the heart of how millions of people experience collaboration. Our product design team works across the full breadth of the platform, from the foundational canvas experience to the emerging AI\-powered capabilities that are redefining how teams think, create, and build together. We're a team that cares deeply about craft, moves with intention, and believes that great design is inseparable from great outcomes.
   

  

 As Miro continues to grow and evolve, the design team is scaling to meet that ambition. We're investing in leadership that can raise the bar on both the quality of our work and the health of our teams, people who understand that building a great design org and shipping great product experiences are the same job.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Director of Product Design, you will lead a small team and be an active designer yourself. This is not a role where leadership means distance from the work. You'll be the creative director for your area of the product, shape how design thinks about problems and solutions, and then roll up your sleeves to ensure the execution matches the vision.
   

  

 This role is critical because Miro is at an inflection point. AI is changing what collaboration software can and should be, and the design decisions made now will shape how teams around the world work for years to come. You'll have the scope, the resources, and the mandate to do some of the most consequential design work of your career.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Set the creative vision for your product area and hold the bar for it — not just in words, but in the work itself. You'll define what good looks like, then stay close enough to the craft to know when you're getting there and when you're not.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of product designers across multiple levels, building a culture where rigorous critique and psychological safety exist in the same room.
* Get your hands dirty at the moments that matter, shaping early frameworks when the problem is still fuzzy, writing the interaction logic that unlocks a stuck design, pushing the details on a surface that's going to be seen by millions.
* Drive design strategy across the full Discover, Define, and Deliver lifecycle, making sure the team is asking the right questions before they're crafting the right answers.
* Align stakeholders across Product, Engineering, and Analytics around a shared design direction, and hold that direction with conviction through the ambiguity and tradeoffs of real product development.
* Run design critiques that are genuinely useful: direct, and focused on making the work better rather than making everyone comfortable.
* Spot gaps in team capability and make the case for what we need to build — through hiring, development, or how we structure the work.


**What You’ll Need**
* 10\+ years of product design experience, with at least 4 years leading and managing teams in a technology company.
* A portfolio that demonstrates both strong strategic thinking and high\-quality craft — work that you shaped at the system level alongside work where your hands were directly on the pixels.
* Proven experience designing AI\-powered or AI\-adjacent product experiences, with a clear point of view on what good looks like when the system is dynamic, generative, or probabilistic.
* Deep fluency with modern design tools, particularly Figma, and comfort working within or evolving a mature design system.


**What's In It For You**
 We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning \& Development stipend. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. If you would like to learn more about location\-specific benefits, please refer to our Global Miro benefits board.
   

  

*The reasonably estimated salary range is specific to New York and may not be applicable to other locations. Final compensation and total package components will be based on individual factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. The range for this role is:*
 New York salary range
   

  

 $237,000—$356,000 USD
   

  

**About Miro**
 Miro is a visual workspace for innovation that enables distributed teams of any size to build the next big thing. The platform's infinite canvas enables teams to lead engaging workshops and meetings, design products, brainstorm ideas, and more. Miro, co\-headquartered in San Francisco and Amsterdam, serves more than 100M users and 250,000 companies collaborate in the Innovation Workspace. Miro was founded in 2011 and currently has more than 1,600 employees in 13 hubs around the world.
   

  

 We are a team of dreamers. We look for individuals who dream big, work hard, and above all stay humble. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do and through our work together we hope to create a supportive, welcoming, and innovative environment. We strive to play as a team to win the world and create a better version of ourselves every day. If this sounds like something that excites you, we want to hear from you!
